title: Generating in the Limit with Infinitely Many Hallucinations
summary: The classic paradigm of language identification in the limit models learning as a game between an adversary, who reveals strings from an unknown target language, and a learner tasked with identifying that language. The recently introduced framework of language generation in the limit shifted the objective to better reflect modern language modeling, requiring the learner to produce valid, unseen strings from the target language. Related work highlighted a fundamental tension: a broad coverage of the target often comes at the cost of validity. We introduce a new notion of precision and recast this problem as the classic recall-precision trade-off. We analyze generation in the limit under varying constraints on enumeration, novelty, and validity, aimed at reflecting settings closer to those encountered by large language models. A key contribution is our analysis of learners that are not eventually valid: we allow infinitely many mistakes, provided their frequency tends to zero so that precision remains one. We show that this relaxation can strictly increase recall when the adversary permanently withholds a large portion of the target language. We also study a continuous relaxation of the novelty constraint that requires only a fixed fraction of outputs to be novel. Taken together, our results move toward a more realistic model of language generation where occasional errors and repetitions are unavoidable, but their rates are controlled.

AI.tldr: 本文在语言生成极限框架下，引入精确度概念，将覆盖度与有效性的矛盾重新表述为经典的召回-精确度权衡，并分析了允许有限错误（错误率趋于零）以及连续新颖性约束下的生成问题。
AI.motivation: 传统语言识别极限模型不适用于现代语言建模，需要一种能同时考虑覆盖度（召回）和有效性（精确）的新型框架来捕捉大语言模型的实际生成行为。
AI.method: 引入精确度概念将问题重构为召回-精确度权衡；分析非最终有效学习器（允许无限次错误但频率趋于零）和连续新颖性约束（仅要求固定比例输出是新颖的）下的语言生成能力。
AI.result: 当对手永久隐藏目标语言大部分内容时，允许错误频率趋于零可严格提升召回率；连续新颖性约束提供了更灵活的生成控制。
AI.conclusion: 本工作推动建立了更现实的语言生成模型，其中偶尔的错误和重复不可避免，但其发生率可被控制。

title: Extracting Knowledge from an Arabic-English Machine-Readable Dictionary Using Information Extraction
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables, Conference version,CITALA 2014: 5th International Conference on Arabic Language Processing,Oujda, Morocco, 26-27 November 2014. Paper listed in archived accepted papers: https://web.archive.org/web/20150205160611/http://citala.org/acceptedpapers.php Original conference site defunct: http://citala.org No proceedings PDF is publicly available
summary: Natural language processing (NLP) applications need large and rich amount of linguistic knowledge. Furthermore, electronic language sources such as dictionaries, encyclopedia, and corpora became available. So, automatic methods are emerged to extract lexical information from those sources to overcome the knowledge acquisition bottleneck. We presented a method to automatically extract lexical information from a machine-readable version of the Arabic-English Al-Mawrid dictionary. We used n-gram analysis and key-word-in-context (KWIC) analysis to discover lexical patterns that manifest morphologic, syntactic, or semantic information. Then, we used hand-crafted rule-based information extraction to extract that information. Furthermore, we used punctuation marks and some heuristics to extract a set of synonyms in a subentry. This study registered high precision for all types of information, high recall for synonyms, and low recall for the other information. The study also showed that the Al-Mawrid has significant amount of derivations (morphologic information) and synonyms, domain labels, and hyponym/hypernym relations (semantic information).

AI.tldr: 提出了一种从阿拉伯语-英语Al-Mawrid机器可读词典中自动提取词汇信息的方法，使用n-gram分析和KWIC分析发现词汇模式，再通过基于规则的方法提取词法、句法和语义信息。
AI.motivation: NLP应用需要大量语言知识，但知识获取存在瓶颈；电子语言资源（词典、百科全书、语料库）的出现使得自动提取词汇信息成为可能，以克服人工获取知识的局限性。
AI.method: 1) 使用n-gram分析和关键词上下文（KWIC）分析发现词汇模式；2) 采用手工编写的基于规则的信息提取方法；3) 利用标点符号和启发式方法提取子词条中的同义词集。
AI.result: 各类信息提取的精确率高；同义词提取的召回率高；其他类型信息（词法、句法等）的召回率较低；Al-Mawrid词典包含大量派生词、同义词、领域标签和上下位关系。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效从Al-Mawrid词典中自动提取词汇信息，精确率表现良好，但除同义词外其他信息的召回率有待提升。

title: Developmental Trajectories of Situation Modeling and Mentalizing in Transformer Language Models
comment: Non-archival submission to the First Workshop on Computational Developmental Linguistics
summary: Recent work suggests that Large Language Models (LLMs) are sensitive to the belief states of agents described by text, as measured by the false belief task (FBT), yet persistent concerns of construct validity remain. We adopt a **developmental perspective**, tracing the pattern of mental state reasoning behavior -- and likely **preconditions** for this behavior -- across multiple training stages in the Olmo2 and Pythia language model suites. We find that above-chance FBT performance depends both on model size and sufficient training volume, emerges relatively late in pretraining, and is most improved by post-training interventions (SFT, DPO) in the condition most diagnostic of mentalizing (False Belief, Implicit). However, FBT performance is fragile: consistent with past work, the use of non-factive verbs (e.g., thinks) increases false belief attributions even in the True Belief condition. To contextualize these findings, we track the emergence of **situation modeling**: the ability to report on basic factual properties of a described scene. Situation modeling accuracy generally precedes and exceeds FBT accuracy, yet situational representations also prove surprisingly incoherent in certain respects: when asked about the knowledge states of the Antagonist agent -- who always knows the item's true location -- Olmo2 13b is consistently influenced both by the Target agent's knowledge state and the presence of non-factive verbs. Together, these results suggest that larger, sufficiently trained models build partially coherent situation models in a developmentally appropriate sequence, yet display surprising fragility -- highlighting the value of developmental and stress-testing approaches for evaluating LLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文从发展心理学视角，系统研究了LLM在不同训练阶段的心理理论（ToM）能力（特别是错误信念任务FBT）和情境建模能力的涌现规律，发现FBT性能依赖模型规模与训练量、出现较晚，且后训练（SFT/DPO）能显著提升，但整体脆弱易受语言干扰；情境建模能力先于FBT出现但同样存在不一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明LLM对文本描述的信念状态敏感，但构念效度（construct validity）问题一直存在争议。作者希望从发展视角出发，系统追踪心理推理能力在模型训练不同阶段的涌现规律及其前提条件，以更严谨地评估LLM是否真正具备心理理论能力。
AI.method: 采用Olmo2和Pythia两个语言模型系列，在多个训练阶段（预训练不同阶段、有/无后训练SFT/DPO）进行错误信念任务（FBT）测试，同时引入情境建模（situation modeling）任务作为对照，并操纵动词类型（事实性vs非事实性动词）来检验模型的脆弱性。
AI.result: (1) FBT超越随机水平依赖模型规模和充分训练量，在预训练后期才涌现；(2) 后训练（SFT/DPO）在最具诊断性的条件（错误信念×隐式）下提升最显著；(3) FBT表现脆弱，非事实性动词（如thinks）会错误地增加错误信念归因；(4) 情境建模准确率普遍先于且高于FBT，但Olmo2 13b在评估反方（始终知晓真相）的知识状态时，仍受目标方的知识状态和非事实性动词影响。
AI.conclusion: 更大规模、训练充分的模型能以符合发展序列的方式构建部分连贯的情境模型，但表现出惊人的脆弱性。这凸显了采用发展视角和压力测试方法评估LLM能力的重要价值。

title: Recursive Self-Evolving Agents via Held-Out Selection
summary:
LLM agents are increasingly improved without weight updates by evolving a natural-language artifact, such as reflections, workflows, playbooks, cheatsheets, or optimized prompts, that conditions a frozen policy. Such methods are typically reported as wins on the single benchmark where they help. We study them apples-to-apples and surface a sharper picture. We introduce RSEA, a Recursive Self-Evolving Agent that carries a compact three-layer natural-language state: an imperative strategy, reusable skills, and a procedural playbook. Across generations, RSEA rewrites all three layers from its own trajectories and commits a candidate only if it does not regress on a disjoint held-out split, using a strict keep-better gate.
  Across four diverse benchmarks, ALFWorld, GAIA, (τ)-bench, and WebShop, and six faithful baselines, ReAct, Reflexion, GEPA, AWM, ACE, and Dynamic Cheatsheet, all evaluated on one shared local backbone, we find three main results. First, no artifact universally wins. RSEA is the strongest single-pass method on ALFWorld, reaching 69.3% compared with 64.6% for ReAct (McNemar (p=0.015)), and reaches 79.4% with retry, the best overall result. However, concrete-workflow induction, represented by AWM, is best on the strong-backbone tool-use tasks. Second, unguarded context evolution is high-variance and unsafe. Dynamic Cheatsheet, which curates context online without a held-out gate, is near-best on ALFWorld at 70.7%, yet collapses on WebShop, with a score of 0.14 compared with 0.43 for ReAct. Third, RSEA's strict held-out selection is what makes recursive self-evolution monotone-safe: it never significantly underperforms the base agent on any benchmark and falls back to vanilla ReAct when evolved context would hurt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSEA方法，一种递归自我进化智能体，通过三层自然语言状态（策略、技能、剧本）进行无权重更新的自我改进。在四个基准测试中与六个基线方法对比，发现：没有一种神器能普遍获胜；无保护的上下文进化高方差且不安全；RSEA的严格保持门控机制使递归自我进化单调安全，不会显著低于基础智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过自然语言工件（如反思、工作流、提示优化等）进行无权重更新的改进方法，通常仅在单一基准上报告成功，缺乏跨基准的公平对比，且未系统研究不同工件的通用性和潜在风险。
AI.method: 提出RSEA（Recursive Self-Evolving Agent），维护三层自然语言状态：命令式策略、可复用技能和程序化剧本。每一代通过自身轨迹重写三层，并使用严格的保持更好门控（held-out gate）——仅当候选版本在不相交的保留集上不退化时才提交。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、GAIA、(τ)-bench和WebShop四个基准上，RSEA在ALFWorld上达到69.3%（单次）和79.4%（重试），优于ReAct的64.6%。但AWM在强骨干工具任务上最佳。无保护的Dynamic Cheatsheet在ALFWorld达70.7%却在WebShop坍塌至0.14。RSEA在所有基准上均未显著低于基础智能体。
AI.conclusion: 没有一种自然语言工件在所有任务上普适最优；无保护的上下文进化存在高方差和坍塌风险；RSEA的严格保留集选择机制是实现单调安全递归自我进化的关键，确保不会比基础智能体更差。

title: Legal Domain Adaptation of Modern BERT Models
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), June 9-12, 2026, Singapore
summary: We investigate domain adaptation of modern BERT models in the legal domain. We further pre-train ModernBERT on all US court opinions using the masked language modeling objective. Although ModernBERT has been trained on roughly 500x more data than original BERT, we still find that this model benefits from further pre-training and domain adaptation in the legal domain: we report significant improvements compared to vanilla ModernBERT on all datasets connected to US court opinions. We find gains similar to those reported in early work on domain adaptation of BERT-like models. However, from scratch pre-training does not match the performance of further pre-training an existing ModernBERT checkpoint in our experiments. The resulting models are capable of processing sequences up to 8,192 tokens, and can be used to compute meaningful embeddings of legal passages, or could quickly rerank hundreds of legal passages for a given search query. We release all model checkpoints publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了现代BERT模型在法律领域的域适应性，通过对ModernBERT在美国法院意见上进行掩码语言建模的进一步预训练，发现尽管ModernBERT已有大量预训练数据，但法律领域适配仍能带来显著性能提升，并公开了模型权重。
AI.motivation: 探究现代BERT模型在法律领域的域适应效果，验证在已有大规模预训练基础上，进一步领域预训练是否仍能带来收益。
AI.method: 使用掩码语言建模目标，对美国所有法院意见进行进一步预训练，适配ModernBERT模型到法律领域。
AI.result: 相比原始ModernBERT，在法律相关数据集上取得显著性能提升，增益与早期BERT域适应工作相当；但从头预训练不如基于已有检查点进一步预训练。
AI.conclusion: 即使ModernBERT已在大规模数据上预训练，法律领域的进一步预训练仍能有效提升下游任务表现，且模型支持8192 tokens长序列处理，可用于法律段落嵌入和搜索重排序。

title: Memory-Augmented LSTM Autoencoder for Unsupervised Activity Recognition with IMU Sensor Fusion
summary: HAR using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors is vital for healthcare monitoring and rehabilitation. Despite deep learning advancements, major challenges remain: reliance on labeled data, multi-sensor fusion complexity, and the limited ability of unsupervised methods to capture spatiotemporal dependencies. These issues are pronounced in real-world scenarios with noisy data, overlapping activities, and missing labels. We propose a fully unsupervised spatiotemporal feature fusion framework using a memory-augmented autoencoder. It enhances activity representations via short temporal windows of multi-sensor IMU data, enabling real-time applications. Our framework extracts hierarchical static features via a Stacked Autoencoder, fusing them within and across sensors. A sequence-to-sequence LSTM Autoencoder then temporally refines these features, incorporating historical motion patterns without labels. We analyze key hyperparameters to identify configurations that maximize feature separability under short-window constraints. Evaluated on DaLiAc and PAMAP2 using realistic inter-class window segmentation, our method achieves 96.6% and 98.4% accuracy, respectively, surpassing supervised baselines and unsupervised approaches. Our method improves feature separability by up to 9% despite shorter temporal windows. While our realistic inter-class segmentation reduces accuracy by ~7%, it was intentionally adopted to better reflect real-world activity transitions and practical relevance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种完全无监督的时空特征融合框架，使用记忆增强自编码器处理多传感器IMU数据，在DaLiAc和PAMAP2数据集上分别达到96.6%和98.4%的准确率，超越了有监督和无监督基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法面临三大挑战：依赖标注数据、多传感器融合复杂、无监督方法难以捕捉时空依赖关系，尤其在有噪声、活动重叠和标签缺失的真实场景中问题更为突出。
AI.method: 采用记忆增强自编码器框架，通过短时间窗口处理多传感器IMU数据；先用堆叠自编码器提取层次化静态特征并在传感器内外融合，再用序列到序列LSTM自编码器进行时间维度细化，融入历史运动模式，全程无需标签。
AI.result: 在DaLiAc和PAMAP2上分别达到96.6%和98.4%的准确率，特征可分性提升高达9%，采用更真实的跨类分割后准确率下降约7%但更贴近实际场景。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无监督框架在短时间窗口约束下仍能实现优异的特征可分性和分类精度，更真实的评估设置验证了方法的实际应用价值。

title: Data and Evaluation Closed-Loop for Model Capability Enhancement
summary: Model capability is the central variable in LLM pre-training, yet is never observed directly: data shapes it prospectively, while evaluation reveals it only retrospectively, compressing samples, prompts, decoding, and scoring rules into one noisy score. Practical optimization runs this backward: a failure is observed first, and the engineer must infer the corpus fix. The two sides speak incompatible vocabularies -- benchmark names and per-sample correctness versus data sources, domains, and quality labels -- so this inference is usually intuition, not method. We close this gap with the \emph{capability slice}: a group of evaluation samples sharing background condition, task type, solving operation, and output constraint -- precise enough to localize a single weakness yet stable enough to survive aggregation, unlike a benchmark name, too coarse, or a single sample, too noisy. Built around this unit, an evaluation taxonomy, a non-instruction data taxonomy, and mapping rules form a closed loop turning a benchmark-level failure into a targeted, testable data intervention. We test this loop on two case studies pulling in opposite directions. First, the loop rules the data out: continued pre-training drives BBH down by $-46.82\%$, but diagnosis traces this to a single masked \texttt{\textless EOS\textgreater} loss rather than weakened reasoning; restoring it recovers BBH to $66.44$, above the original checkpoint, without changing the data. Second, the loop rules the data in: a persistent math-reasoning weakness is decomposed by solving operation into specific failing combinations, and a weakness-targeted sampling procedure built from it lifts AIME2025/AIME2026 Pass@128 from $6.67$/$0.00$ to $26.67$ each. The same unmodified loop reaches opposite, correct verdicts in both cases, showing the evaluation-to-data inference can be routine, auditable, and experimentally validated rather than intuitive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“能力切片”概念，构建了一个从评估失败到数据干预的闭环方法，使LLM预训练中的评估-数据推断从直觉经验变为可审计、可验证的标准化流程。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练中模型能力是核心变量但无法直接观测，评估只能给出含噪的单一分数，而实际优化中工程师需从评估失败反向推断数据修复方案，但评估侧（基准名、样本正确性）与数据侧（来源、领域、质量标签）使用不同词汇，导致推断依赖直觉而非方法。
AI.method: 定义“能力切片”——一组具有相同背景条件、任务类型、求解操作和输出约束的评估样本，兼具精确定位单点弱点和稳定聚合的双重特性。围绕此单元构建评估分类法、非指令数据分类法和映射规则，形成从基准级失败到针对性数据干预的闭环。
AI.result: 在两项反向案例中验证：1）持续预训练导致BBH下降46.82%，闭环诊断为掩码<EOS>损失问题而非推理能力减弱，修复后BBH升至66.44；2）数学推理弱点通过求解操作分解为特定失败组合，针对性采样使AIME2025/AIME2026 Pass@128从6.67/0.00分别提升至26.67。
AI.conclusion: 同一闭环在两项截然不同的案例中均得出正确结论，证明评估到数据的推断可以是常规化、可审计、可实验验证的，而非依赖直觉。

title: Turn-Averaged SAEs for Feature Discovery and Long-Context Attribution
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a useful tool for extracting interpretable features in language models. However, standard SAE architectures operate on individual token activations, meaning that the number of active features scales linearly with context length, and studying long model transcripts becomes difficult. We introduce turn-averaged SAEs, which represent a single Human or Assistant turn with a fixed number of features by learning to reconstruct the average model activation across the turn. We find that turn-averaged features describe a single turn's high-level characteristics more completely than per-token features when judged by an LLM. We also demonstrate that turn-averaged SAEs greatly simplify common downstream uses of SAEs like attribution graphs. Broadly, turn-averaged SAEs make interpretability techniques practical at long context lengths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"turn-averaged SAEs"的方法，通过学习重构对话回合的平均模型激活，用固定数量的特征表示单个Human或Assistant回合，解决了标准SAE在长上下文中特征数量线性增长的问题，简化了归因图等下游应用。
AI.motivation: 标准SAE对每个token激活单独操作，导致活跃特征数量随上下文长度线性增长，难以处理长模型记录。需要一种方法能够用固定特征表示更长的语义单元（如对话回合），以便在长上下文中进行可解释性分析。
AI.method: 提出turn-averaged SAE，将单个Human或Assistant回合作为基本分析单元，学习重构该回合的平均模型激活，从而用固定数量的特征表示整个回合。
AI.result: turn-averaged特征比per-token特征能更完整地描述单回合的高层特征（经LLM评估），并显著简化了归因图等下游可解释性应用。
AI.conclusion: turn-averaged SAE使得可解释性技术在长上下文场景下变得实用，是对现有SAE方法的重要扩展。

title: Zero-Label Driving Scenario Complexity Detection via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture
summary: Identifying complex and safety-critical driving scenarios in large unlabelled datasets is an important but expensive problem. Existing approaches rely on human annotators, supervised classifiers, or carefully engineered rule sets, all of which require substantial prior knowledge about what constitutes a difficult scenario. We ask whether a model can discover scenario complexity on its own, with no labels at any stage. We train a minimal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) on structured agent state data from the nuPlan mini dataset and use the temporal prediction error as a zero-shot complexity score. Without access to any ground-truth labels during training or evaluation setup, the model assigns significantly higher scores to scenarios involving unprotected turns, crosswalk interactions, and pedestrian proximity, and significantly lower scores to lane-following and stationary-traffic scenarios. We validate this finding through four ablation experiments that isolate the source of the signal, and through a downstream anomaly detection evaluation that achieves Average Precision of 0.512 against a 0.436 chance baseline. The results show that temporal prediction error in a self-supervised latent world model is a practical proxy for driving scenario complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需任何标签的自监督方法，通过联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的时序预测误差来评估驾驶场景的复杂性，在nuPlan数据集上验证了该方法能有效区分复杂场景（如无保护转弯、行人交互）与简单场景（如车道保持、静止交通），并通过消融实验和异常检测任务证实了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 从无标注的大规模驾驶数据中自动识别复杂和安全性关键的场景是一个重要但昂贵的问题。现有方法依赖人工标注、监督分类器或精心设计的规则集，都需要关于何为困难场景的先验知识。作者希望探索模型能否在完全没有标签的情况下自主发现场景的复杂性。
AI.method: 在nuPlan mini数据集的智能体状态数据上训练一个轻量级的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），利用时序预测误差作为零样本复杂性评分。无需任何标签进行训练或评估。
AI.result: 模型对无保护转弯、人行横道交互和行人接近场景赋予显著更高的分数，对车道保持和静止交通场景赋予显著更低的分数。通过四项消融实验验证了信号来源，并在下游异常检测任务中达到0.512的平均精确率（AP），高于0.436的随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 自监督潜在世界模型中的时序预测误差可以作为驾驶场景复杂性的实用代理指标，无需任何标注即可有效识别复杂场景。

title: Depth-Staggered Fibonacci Spacing for Sparse Attention: Static Schedules Beat Learned Dilation and Extrapolate Where Dense Attention Fails
summary: We study sparse self-attention in which each query attends to a dense local window plus a set of Fibonacci-spaced offsets, with a per-layer scalar alpha that compresses or expands the spacing. Across 21 language models trained under one matched recipe (60M parameters, 512 hidden, 16 layers, 426M tokens), we compare four ways of setting alpha across depth: fixed, per-layer learned, a static linear stagger, and a coprime (anti-gridding) reassignment of that stagger, together with a reach-matched power-of-2 control. Three results stand out. First, a static per-layer stagger improves perplexity over both fixed and learned alpha, and the gain is base-agnostic: applying the same stagger to a power-of-2 base lifts it above fixed Fibonacci and to parity with learned Fibonacci attention. Second, learning per layer is inert: it does not beat the static schedule and costs roughly five times the inference latency. Third, and most consequential, all sparse variants extrapolate to four times their training length with little or no degradation, whereas a recipe-matched dense baseline collapses (perplexity rises by 201% at 4x length); we attribute this to fixed-offset attention only ever querying relative positions seen during training. We also report two honest negatives: at training length the best sparse model has about 26% higher perplexity than the dense baseline, and the staggering gain is uniform across context positions rather than concentrated at long range.

AI.tldr: 研究了Fibonacci间隔的稀疏自注意力机制，发现静态分层交错策略优于固定或学习型alpha，所有稀疏变体可外推至4倍训练长度，而密集基线则崩溃。
AI.motivation: 探索稀疏自注意力中查询-键对的优化布局方式，特别是如何通过分层参数alpha的设置来提升模型性能和长序列外推能力。
AI.method: 在21个语言模型（60M参数，16层）上，比较了四种alpha设置方式：固定、逐层学习、静态线性交错、互质重新分配，以及2的幂次基线控制。
AI.result: 1）静态分层交错优于固定和学习型alpha；2）逐层学习效果不明显且推理延迟高；3）所有稀疏变体可外推至4倍训练长度，而密集基线困惑度上升201%；4）最佳稀疏模型困惑度比密集基线高26%。
AI.conclusion: 静态分层交错的稀疏注意力在长序列外推上表现优异，但训练长度时仍存在困惑度差距，且增益在上下文位置上是均匀的而非集中于长程依赖。

title: Data Provenance for Image Auto-Regressive Generation
summary: Image autoregressive models (IARs) have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual content generation, achieving photorealistic quality and rapid synthesis through the next-token prediction paradigm adapted from large language models. As these models become widely accessible, robust data provenance is required to reliably trace IAR-generated images to the source model that synthesized them. This is critical to prevent the spread of misinformation, detect fraud, and attribute harmful content. We find that although IAR-generated images often appear visually identical to real images, their generation process introduces characteristic patterns in their outputs, which serves as a reliable provenance signal for the generated images. Leveraging this, we present a post-hoc framework that enables the robust detection of such patterns for provenance tracing. Notably, our framework does not require modifications of the generative process or outputs. Thereby, it is applicable in contexts where prior watermarking methods cannot be used, such as for generated content that is already published without additional marks and for models that do not integrate watermarking. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across a wide range of IARs, highlighting its high potential for robust data provenance tracing in autoregressive image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需修改生成过程的后验框架，通过检测图像自回归模型(IAR)生成过程中留下的特征模式，实现对IAR生成图像的来源追踪，在多个IAR模型上展示了高有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着IAR模型在视觉内容生成中广泛应用，迫切需要可靠的图像来源追溯技术，以防止虚假信息传播、检测欺诈行为并追溯有害内容，而现有水印方法无法适用于已发布的、未添加额外标记的生成内容。
AI.method: 提出一种后验(post-hoc)框架，利用IAR模型生成过程中引入的特征模式作为信号，在不修改生成过程或输出的前提下，检测这些模式以实现来源追踪。
AI.result: 在多个IAR模型上验证了该方法在图像来源追溯中的高有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于无法使用水印的场景（如已发布的无标记内容或未集成水印的模型），为自回归图像生成中的数据来源追溯提供了高效方案。

title: SEAD: Competence-Aware On-Policy Distillation via Entropy-Guided Supervision
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has a property absent in offline distillation and RL: teacher supervision quality depends on student competence. Incoherent rollouts yield noisy gradients; already-mastered tokens yield redundant ones. This creates waste at three scales (tokens, training phases, and prompts) yet existing methods supervise uniformly. We introduce SEAD, which uses entropy as a unified probe of this competence-dependent degradation at three scales: (1) joint teacher-student entropy partitions tokens into zones receiving tailored divergences or zero gradient (approx. 50% skipped); (2) a cosine schedule anneals from forward to reverse KL as competence grows; (3) a competence-gated curriculum introduces prompts easy-to-hard. These components are symbiotically necessary: token selection requires coherent rollouts (curriculum), annealing requires monotonic improvement (also curriculum). On OLMo-3 (7B to 32B), SEAD achieves +4.8 avg accuracy over vanilla OPD across six math benchmarks, with ablations confirming super-additive interactions.

AI.tldr: SEAD通过熵作为统一探针，在三个尺度上解决同策略蒸馏中因学生能力变化导致的监督效率问题，在OLMo-3上平均准确率提升4.8%。
AI.motivation: 同策略蒸馏中教师监督质量依赖于学生能力，导致不连贯轨迹产生噪声梯度、已掌握token产生冗余梯度，造成token、训练阶段和prompt三个尺度的浪费，而现有方法采用统一监督方式未能解决此问题。
AI.method: (1) 联合师生熵将token分区，分配不同散度或零梯度（约50%跳过）；(2) 余弦调度从前向KL退火到反向KL；(3) 能力门控课程从易到难引入prompt。三个组件共生协同。
AI.result: 在OLMo-3（7B到32B）上，SEAD在六个数学基准上比原始OPD平均准确率提升4.8%，消融实验证实超加性交互。
AI.conclusion: SEAD通过熵驱动的多尺度优化有效解决了同策略蒸馏中的监督浪费问题，且三个组件具有共生必要性。

title: SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting: Per-Player Attention with Agreement-Based Ensembling
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. SoccerNet 2026 challenge technical report
summary: We present our submission to the SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting challenge, which uses a two-stage pipeline: a Track-Aware Action Detector (TAAD) produces per-player action logits from broadcast video, and a Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) transformer converts game-state features and TAAD logits into structured event sequences. We improve the TAAD with a temporal transformer that adds cross-frame context, alongside several training fixes. For the DST stage, we introduce a two-stage per-player attention mechanism operating on game-state features, and show that a spatial-first attention ordering (cross-player attention before temporal attention) improves validation Macro-F1 by 1.87%. To exploit architectural diversity, we train four model variants and combine them with a Weighted Event Fusion ensemble that applies agreement filtering to suppress single-model false positives while preserving recall, plus a dedicated exception for the rare tackle class. Our final system improves the challenge Macro-F1 from a baseline of 48.6 to 58.94.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段管道（TAAD + DST），用于SoccerNet 2026球员中心足球事件检测挑战，通过集成多种模型变体和加权事件融合，将Macro-F1从48.6提升至58.94。
AI.motivation: 现有球员级足球事件检测方法在广播视频中定位球员动作时缺乏跨帧上下文和结构化序列建模能力，导致检测准确率不足。
AI.method: 两阶段管道：第一阶段TAAD使用时间Transformer增加跨帧上下文产生球员动作logits；第二阶段DST通过空间优先注意力（先跨球员注意力再时间注意力）处理游戏状态特征和TAAD logits生成结构化事件序列。训练4个模型变体，采用加权事件融合集成，含协议过滤抑制假阳性并为罕见tackle类设置例外。
AI.result: 验证集Macro-F1提升1.87%（空间优先注意力），最终系统Macro-F1从基线48.6提升至58.94。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段管道结合空间优先注意力和模型集成有效提升了球员中心足球事件检测性能，尤其对罕见类别的处理策略值得借鉴。

title: Search for Truth from Reasoning: A Dynamic Representation Editing Framework for Steering LLM Trajectories
summary: Current approaches to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, such as Chain-of-Thought and "Wait" prompts, primarily encourage models to think more, yet often fail to guide them toward Truth. While Representation Editing (RepE) offers a intrinsic control, its application to dynamic reasoning trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by investigating the geometry of truth within unfolding reasoning chains. We uncover three critical insights: (1) Truth is encoded at the sentence level and is entangled with latent reasoning patterns; (2) Effective intervention follows an Uncertainty Principle and a Decay Effect, requiring localization to early, high-entropy forks; (3) Naive steering vectors suffer from noise, risking collateral damage to correct trajectories. Based on these findings, we propose DynaSteer, a dynamic RepE framework. DynaSteer employs pattern clustering to disentangle reasoning manifolds and utilizes Fisher-LDA to project purified truth. By dynamically monitoring lookahead entropy, it selectively steers and rolls back trajectories only when necessary. Comprehensive experimental results on several MATH benchmark verify the effectiveness of DynaSteer, and experiments on out-of-domain coding tasks further confirm its generalization ability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tianlwang/DynaSteer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DynaSteer框架，通过动态表示编辑技术引导LLM推理走向真理，在数学推理和代码生成任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如CoT、Wait提示）虽能促使模型"多思考"，但无法有效引导模型走向真理。表示编辑（RepE）虽提供内在控制，但在动态推理轨迹中的应用尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出DynaSteer动态RepE框架：(1) 模式聚类解耦推理流形；(2) Fisher-LDA投影提纯"真理"方向；(3) 动态监测前向熵，选择性干预并回滚轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个MATH基准测试上验证了有效性，并在域外编程任务上确认了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DynaSteer通过动态、精确的表示编辑有效引导推理轨迹趋向真理，且具有良好泛化性。

title: Correct codes for the wrong reasons? validating LLMs as measurement instruments for theoretical constructs
summary: When a large language model (LLM) codes a construct in text as a human annotator would, that agreement makes the LLM a reliable coder. Yet reliability leaves construct validity untouched. The instrument may be theory-naive, reaching the code through a correlate that meets none of the demands the construct's theory makes, and no current method tells that apart from genuine measurement. We propose grain calibration as a method that closes the gap. It decomposes a construct into clause-level components, tests each against the text with extractive evidence, and combines the results through an explicit, theory-derived rule. Because the rule is stated rather than lodged in one opaque pass, its structure is evidence about the process rather than the output. It shows which components settled a code, and, when the code is wrong, whether a component was missed or an adjacent construct mistaken for it. Validation shifts from scoring an instrument's outputs against an annotator to showing that the instrument runs on the construct its theory specifies.

AI.tldr: 提出"粒度校准"方法，将构念分解为子句级组件进行独立验证，以区分LLM编码的真实测量与虚假相关，将验证标准从输出一致性转向理论驱动的过程透明度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅检查LLM编码与人类标注者的一致性（信度），但无法区分真实测量与理论无知的虚假相关（构念效度缺失），需要一种能揭示编码过程而非仅输出结果的方法。
AI.method: 粒度校准法：将构念分解为子句级组件，用提取式证据逐一检验文本，再通过显式、理论推导的规则组合结果，使编码过程结构化且可审计。
AI.result: 该方法能识别哪些组件决定了最终编码，并在编码错误时区分是遗漏了组件还是混淆了相邻构念。
AI.conclusion: 验证应从将工具输出与标注者评分对标，转向证明该工具运行在理论指定的构念之上。

title: Automated Quality Assessment of Geospatial Vector Data: A GeoAI Approach using Spatial Representation Learning
summary: Geospatial vector data quality is a foundational research topic in GIS, yet classic rule-based quality assessment algorithms often struggle with diverse urban morphologies and massive data volumes. Recently, Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) shows promising potential for automating geospatial analysis, while its application to native vector data remains largely underexplored. To fill this research gap, we proposed Topo4Vec, an automated GeoAI framework, designed for scalable vector data quality assessment via advanced Spatial Representation Learning (SRL). Specifically, Topo4Vec relax the labor-intensive manual annotation process via topological error simulation, such as overlapping polygons and street network connectivity errors e.g., overshoots and undershoots. Then, it leverages state-of-the-art SRL approaches to encode complex, native vector geometries (e.g., polylines and polygons) into a latent space where topological errors are isolated from valid ones. A systematic performance evaluation across three study areas (Los Angeles, Munich, and Singapore) demonstrates the effectiveness and robustness of Topo4Vec, achieving a peak accuracy of 0.99 for detecting overlapping building footprints and 0.60 for overshoots and undershoots in street networks. Moreover, lessons learned from Topo4Vec shed a promising light into a scalable and autonomous GeoAI approach for large-scale vector data consistency and quality monitoring within the fast-growing geospatial data ecosystems. The code and data used in the paper are made openly available in https://figshare.com/s/612148eeb4bccadbd715.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Topo4Vec，一个基于GeoAI的自动化框架，通过空间表征学习实现大规模矢量数据质量评估，在建筑物和街道网络拓扑错误检测中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的矢量数据质量评估算法难以应对多样化的城市形态和海量数据，而GeoAI在原生矢量数据上的应用尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 通过拓扑错误模拟（如多边形重叠、街道网络过冲/欠冲）放松人工标注负担，利用先进的空间表征学习将矢量几何编码到潜在空间，分离拓扑错误与有效数据。
AI.result: 在洛杉矶、慕尼黑和新加坡三个研究区评估，建筑物重叠检测准确率达0.99，街道网络过冲/欠冲检测准确率达0.60。
AI.conclusion: Topo4Vec为大规模地理空间数据生态系统中的矢量数据一致性和质量监控提供了可扩展、自主的GeoAI解决方案。

title: Aristotelian Virtue Profiling of LLMs through Ethical Dilemmas
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often face ethical tradeoffs in which several responses may be defensible but express different priorities, such as fairness, honesty, courage, or restraint. We introduce VirtueMap, a framework for describing these patterns through an Aristotelian virtue-ethics lens. Instead of asking for a single correct answer, VirtueMap asks humans or LLMs to rank all five responses to each of seven general, non-lethal, non-political, and non-religious ethical dilemmas. To define the reference orderings used for scoring, we first proposed, for each dilemma and virtue, an ordering of the five responses from most to least expressive of that virtue. We then collected more than 100 respondent evaluations per ordering and retained it as operational ground truth only when at least 95% confirmed it. Rankings are scored against these retained orderings using normalized Borda alignment, yielding profiles over Practical Wisdom, Justice, Truthfulness, Courage, and Temperance. We apply VirtueMap to nine LLM families in a repeated-run evaluation and find high mean rank consistency (90.3%), with the largest differences appearing on Courage, Temperance, and Justice. We also release an interactive website that computes profiles locally in the browser and compares respondents with measured LLM profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VirtueMap框架，基于亚里士多德德性伦理学，通过七组伦理困境的五种回应排序来刻画LLM在公平、诚实、勇气等德性上的表现，并在九个LLM系列中验证了90.3%的高排名一致性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在伦理决策中常面临多种合理但优先级不同的回应（如公平vs诚实），现有方法缺乏系统描述这种德性偏好模式的框架。
AI.method: VirtueMap框架包含七组非政治/非宗教/非致命伦理困境，每组提供五个回应选项。先由研究者提出每种德性下的参考排序，再收集超100人评价，仅保留95%以上一致的排序作为标准。使用归一化Borda对齐算法将模型排名与标准排序对比，生成实践智慧、正义、诚实、勇气、节制五个维度的画像。
AI.result: 对九个LLM系列重复测试，平均排名一致性达90.3%，最大差异出现在勇气、节制和正义三个维度。
AI.conclusion: VirtueMap能有效量化LLM的德性偏好模式，并提供了一个交互式网站用于本地计算和比较。

title: Phonological Perception of Sign Language Models
summary: Sign languages are compositional systems where meaning arises by combining sublexical phonological parameters, such as handshape, location, and movement. While deep learning models for Sign Language Recognition (SLR) have achieved increased performance on translation benchmarks, it remains unclear whether these models distinguish abstract phonological features or merely rely on low-level statistical correlations. This work evaluates the phonological perception of SLR models trained on American Sign Language (ASL) by probing phonological sensitivity using minimal pairs and evaluating representational alignment with human behavioral data. Our results reveal that SLR models exhibit emergent phonological sensitivity, but with clear architectural trade-offs: pose-based models are sensitive to handshape contrasts, while pixel-based models better capture location changes. Furthermore, pose-based models learn latent representations that correlate with human perceptual similarity judgments (r~0.49). These findings suggest that while SLR models exhibit emergent phonology, current training paradigms are insufficient to scale them beyond their architectural inductive biases.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了手语识别模型对音位参数的感知能力，发现基于姿态的模型对handshape敏感，基于像素的模型对location敏感，且姿态模型表征与人类感知判断存在相关性（r~0.49），但现有训练范式无法超越架构归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习在手语识别任务上取得了进展，但模型是否真正区分抽象音位特征、还是仅依赖低级统计相关性尚不清楚，因此需要评估模型的音位感知能力。
AI.method: 使用最小对立对探测音位敏感性，并评估模型表征与人类行为数据的对齐程度。
AI.result: SLR模型展现出涌现的音位敏感性，但存在架构权衡：基于姿态的模型对手势形状敏感，基于像素的模型对位置变化敏感；姿态模型与人类感知相似性判断相关（r~0.49）。
AI.conclusion: SLR模型虽展现出涌现音位能力，但当前训练范式无法使其超越架构固有的归纳偏置。

title: AnTenA: Actionable and Explainable Tensor Analysis System with Large Language Models
summary:
Accurately explaining hidden patterns in multi-aspect data has typically been done by leveraging labels and/or accompanying auxiliary metadata. However, labels and auxiliary data may be inaccurate (e.g. nonstandard, inconsistent), insufficient (e.g. static tabular metadata for time-dependent recordings), or unavailable. %
We propose \fullmethod (\method), which leverages the knowledge of large language models (LLMs) to explain the hidden patterns in human narratives. \method uses task-agnostic and task-specific prompts to explain extracted co-clustered latent patterns from tensor decomposition. To evaluate these explanations, we test the LLMs on forward and backward inference tasks. % Our demo system is available at https://github.com/dawonahn/ECML_PKDD_AnTenA.

AI.tldr: 提出AnTenA方法，利用大语言模型解释张量分解提取的隐藏模式，无需依赖标签或辅助元数据。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖标签或辅助元数据来解释多维度数据中的隐藏模式，但这些数据可能存在不准确、不充分或不可用的问题。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLMs），通过任务无关和任务特定提示，解释从张量分解中提取的共聚类潜在模式，并在前向和反向推理任务上评估解释质量。
AI.result: 在正向和反向推理任务上测试LLMs的解释能力，验证方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AnTenA能够不依赖标签或辅助数据，利用LLM知识准确解释多维度数据中的隐藏叙事模式。

title: COMPASS: Grounding Composition-Intent Guidance in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Composition is a high-level visual intent that governs where subjects are placed and how a scene is organized, yet current unified multimodal models remain unreliable at fine-grained composition recognition and struggle to turn such intent into controllable generation. We present COMPASS, the first unified multimodal framework that grounds composition-intent control in a single system spanning both composition perception and composition-guided generation, with a shared expert token $τ_c$ as the central intent anchor. On the perception side, COMPASS injects composition expertise into an MoE backbone in a minimally invasive manner and distills the inferred intent into $τ_c$. On the generation side, COMPASS reuses $τ_c$ as a global conditioning signal that steers the denoising trajectory, effectively converting passive composition analysis into explicit layout control. To support systematic instruction-following composition learning and evaluation at scale, we construct Comp-11, a large-scale dataset with an 11-class taxonomy and reasoning-augmented annotations. Extensive experiments show that COMPASS substantially improves category-level composition understanding and delivers more composition-consistent, prompt-faithful generation than strong baselines.

AI.tldr: COMPASS是首个统一的多模态框架，通过共享专家token τ_c实现构图感知与构图引导生成，在构图理解和可控生成任务上均显著优于现有基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型在细粒度构图识别上不可靠，且难以将构图意图转化为可控生成，缺乏一个统一系统同时处理构图感知与生成。
AI.method: COMPASS框架：1) 感知端：将构图专家知识注入MoE骨干网络，将推理出的构图意图蒸馏到共享专家token τ_c中；2) 生成端：重用τ_c作为全局条件信号引导去噪轨迹；3) 构建了包含11类分类体系和推理增强标注的大规模数据集Comp-11。
AI.result: COMPASS在类别级构图理解上显著提升，相比强基线模型生成更符合构图约束、更忠于提示的图像。
AI.conclusion: 统一的构图意图锚定框架能够有效桥接构图感知与可控生成，验证了共享专家token作为中间表示的可行性与有效性。

title: BV-Blend: Uncertainty-Weighted Historical Baselines for Stable Critic-Free RL with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), avoids training a value function (critic) and reduces memory and compute overhead relative to critic-based PPO pipelines for aligning large language models. However, GRPO-style advantage estimation depends on prompt-local (within-prompt-group) reward statistics and can be unstable. In particular, when all rollouts in a prompt group receive identical rewards, the within-group reward variance becomes zero, and group normalization yields zero advantages for that group, impeding learning in cold-start regimes with binary verifiers. We introduce BV-Blend, a critic-free framework that stabilizes advantage estimation by combining prompt-local on-policy statistics with semantic-cluster-conditioned historical moments. BV-Blend maintains EMA-tracked reward moments for each cluster, derives a confidence weight from a standard error of the mean (SEM) proxy, and uses this weight to blend historical and prompt-local baseline and variance statistics into a standardized advantage for PPO-style clipped updates. Experiments on verifiable reasoning benchmarks show that BV-Blend improves training stability and performance, and remains robust in regimes where group-normalized methods may stall.

AI.tldr: BV-Blend是一种无评论家的强化学习框架，通过混合提示局部统计和语义聚类历史时刻来稳定优势估计，解决了GRPO在零方差场景下的学习停滞问题。
AI.motivation: GRPO风格的优势估计依赖提示组内奖励统计，当组内所有rollout获得相同奖励时方差为零，导致优势为零、学习停滞，尤其在冷启动阶段和二值验证器场景下问题突出。
AI.method: BV-Blend维护每个语义聚类的EMA追踪奖励矩，通过标准误代理计算置信权重，融合历史基线/方差与提示局部统计，生成标准化优势用于PPO风格的裁剪更新。
AI.result: 在可验证推理基准上，BV-Blind提升了训练稳定性和性能，在组归一化方法可能停滞的场景下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: BV-Blend有效解决了无评论家RLVR框架中GRPO的零方差学习停滞问题，为基于可验证奖励的大模型对齐提供了更稳定的训练方案。

title: DriftGuard: Safety-Aware Multi-Monitor Detection and Selective Adaptation for Evolving Toxicity Moderation
summary: Automated toxicity moderation systems operate in dynamic online environments where harmful behavior evolves through coded language, shifting targets, and strategic adaptation to enforcement. Existing drift detection methods often focus on global distributional change, but such signals may miss safety-relevant shifts that emerge in localized harm subspaces or high-risk model-error regions. This paper introduces DriftGuard, a safety-aware adaptive moderation framework that combines multi-monitor drift detection with selective model updating. The framework tracks global text drift, identity-harm drift, model uncertainty, toxic-risk drift, and false-negative-risk drift. When safety-relevant change is detected, the model is updated using a hard-mix adaptation set that prioritizes likely false negatives, identity-related high-risk examples, false-positive-risk examples, and uncertain boundary cases. Experiments on Civil Comments temporal shift and Jigsaw-to-DynaHate cross-dataset shift show that safety-aware monitors detect risks missed by global drift alone. Hard-mix adaptation improves toxic recall and accuracy over no-update and random-balanced baselines, raising toxic recall to 0.8777 on Civil Comments and from 0.7107 to 0.8523 on DynaHate. Bootstrap analysis further shows stable DynaHate safety gains, with toxic recall increasing by 0.1418 and false-negative prevalence decreasing by 0.0781. Overall, DriftGuard links safety-aware drift detection to targeted, lightweight model updating for more robust adaptive toxicity moderation.

AI.tldr: DriftGuard是一个安全感知的自适应内容审核框架，通过多监测器漂移检测和硬混合模型更新策略，有效应对在线环境中不断演变的毒性语言，在Civil Comments和DynaHate数据集上显著提升了毒性召回率并降低了假阴性率。
AI.motivation: 现有漂移检测方法主要关注全局分布变化，但可能遗漏局部危害子空间或高风险模型错误区域中出现的安全相关漂移，导致毒性审核系统无法有效应对不断演变的在线有害行为。
AI.method: 提出DriftGuard框架，结合多监测器漂移检测（全局文本漂移、身份危害漂移、模型不确定性、毒性风险漂移、假阴性风险漂移）与选择性模型更新，使用硬混合适应集优先选择假阴性、身份相关高风险、假阳性风险和边界不确定样本进行模型更新。
AI.result: 在Civil Comments上毒性召回率达到0.8777，在DynaHate上从0.7107提升至0.8523；Bootstrap分析显示毒性召回率提升0.1418，假阴性率降低0.0781。
AI.conclusion: 将安全感知的漂移检测与针对性轻量级模型更新相结合，能够实现更鲁棒的自适应毒性审核。

title: GPU-Accelerated Inverse Structural Anastylosis from Block Collapse Dynamics
summary: The physical anastylosis of collapsed architectural monuments -- the meticulous reassembly of fallen stone elements into their original structural configuration -- represents one of the most intellectually demanding challenges in conservation science. Traditional approaches depend heavily on expert archaeologist judgement and manual block-by-block correspondence, a process that is both labour-intensive and inherently subjective. Inspired by the combinatorial complexity of this problem as manifested in the game of Jenga, we present Jenga Inverse Predictor , a GPU-accelerated deep learning framework that addresses structural anastylosis as an inverse prediction task. Given an image of a collapsed block assembly, JIP-2 reconstructs the most probable prior tower configuration by: (1) implementing a complete rigid-body physics engine with OBB/SAT collision detection and a Projected Gauss-Seidel (PGS) contact solver accelerated with Numba JIT and CuPy CUDA; (2) applying the analytical force thresholds of Ziglar (CMU, 2006) -- F_app = 3*mu_s*m*g (Y-axis, torque-free) and F_app = 4*mu_s*m*g (X-axis, torque risk) -- over three friction levels (mu_s in {0.25, 0.40, 0.60}) across 450 simulated episodes; (3) training a dual-stream ResNet-18 that injects a friction one-hot vector and jointly predicts block removal count, per-position removal probabilities, centre-of-mass imbalance, and Ziglar torque risk; and (4) generating a smooth 3-D video of the block-by-block reverse reconstruction. We discuss implications for computer-assisted anastylosis at the UNESCO Maya site of Uxmal, Yucatan, and provide a detailed technical description of the full pipeline, architecture, and loss formulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JIP-2，一个GPU加速的深度学习框架，将建筑倒塌石块的物理重组（anastylosis）视为逆预测任务。该框架结合物理引擎、摩擦力学阈值和双流ResNet-18网络，从倒塌石块图像重建最可能的原始塔状结构，并在UNESCO玛雅遗址Uxmal进行验证。
AI.motivation: 传统建筑石块重组（anastylosis）依赖考古学家的手动逐块对应，过程劳动密集且具有主观性。受Jenga游戏组合复杂性的启发，作者希望利用深度学习实现自动化的结构逆预测。
AI.method: (1) 实现基于OBB/SAT碰撞检测和投影高斯-赛德尔（PGS）接触求解器的完整刚体物理引擎，使用Numba JIT和CuPy CUDA加速；(2) 应用Ziglar分析力阈值（三个摩擦级别），在450个模拟场景中执行；(3) 训练双流ResNet-18，注入摩擦one-hot向量，联合预测块移除数量、位置概率、质心不平衡和Ziglar扭矩风险；(4) 生成平滑的3D反向重建视频。
AI.result: 在450个模拟场景上训练，能够预测块移除数量、位置概率、质心不平衡和扭矩风险，并生成3D重建视频。方法在UNESCO玛雅遗址Uxmal的案例中展示了应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: JIP-2为计算机辅助的石块重组提供了新的自动化框架，有望减少对专家人工判断的依赖，提高anastylosis过程的效率和客观性。代码、数据和视频已开源。

title: The Two Genie Game: Adoption and Welfare in Audit-Grounded AI Governance
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures. Lean 4 formalization and figure scripts: https://github.com/dlewissandy/two-genie-scripts
summary:
We ask under what conditions an agent with a harm-minimizing policy can displace an approval-seeking (RLHF) agent in a competitive market, and when that policy is sufficient to prevent community harm. We use evolutionary game theory (finite-population Moran-Fermi pairwise comparison) to formalize this subject to assumptions of wisher hindsight, peer testimony, a monotone harm ledger, sufficient information density of community feedback, and a finite, depleting resource pool, in a negative-sum environment.
  We show that adoption is favored when the prior distributions on how readily wishers attune to community sentiment are monotone, exhibit endpoint inversion, and have a centro-symmetric pairing property, and demonstrate this with several long-tailed priors (Hill, Pareto, Lomax, Frechet). Where it is favored, a critical adoption level separates communities that drift back to the approval-seeking agent from those for which the audited agent fixes; above that level fixation is the overwhelmingly likely outcome. We derive when fixation is attainable as a bound on the effective (informational) size N_c of the community, which must be small enough to allow fixation before depletion. We present these as Theorems 5.4 and 5.5; the algebraic and finite-grid backbone is machine-checked in Lean 4, with the barrier-crossing asymptotics retained as explicit hypotheses.
  We show that a self-audited agent with a community ledger is not, in general, sufficient to prevent community harm. Sufficiency depends both upon the alignment of the agent's audit with community values and the timeframe over which harm is evaluated. Regardless of alignment, once adoption reaches dominance, the state is absorbing. The same policy that reduced harm under alignment becomes a trap, welfare-negative under misalignment and, even under alignment, one that locks in harm deferred past the adoption horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文通过进化博弈论模型，研究在竞争市场中，采用最小化危害策略的智能体（自审计智能体）能否取代追求认可的智能体（RLHF智能体），并探讨该策略是否足以防止社区危害。研究发现，采纳取决于多种先验分布条件，存在临界采纳水平，且社区规模需足够小才能实现固定。自审计智能体及其社区账本通常不足以完全防止危害，危害是否可控取决于审计与社区价值观的契合度及评估时间框架。
AI.motivation: 探究在竞争市场中，采用最小化危害策略的智能体是否能取代RLHF智能体，以及该策略是否足以防止社区危害。
AI.method: 使用有限种群Moran-Fermi成对比较的进化博弈论进行形式化建模，假设包括许愿者事后视角、同行证词、单调危害账本、社区反馈信息密度足够以及有限可耗尽资源池，在负和环境中进行分析。
AI.result: 采纳在多种长尾先验（Hill、Pareto、Lomax、Frechet）下受青睐。存在临界采纳水平，低于该水平社区退回RLHF智能体，高于则自审计智能体固定。固定可达性取决于社区有效信息规模N_c的上界。自审计智能体通常不足以防止社区危害，取决于审计对齐程度和评估时间框架。
AI.conclusion: 自审计智能体在达到主导地位后状态不可逆；在对齐时减少危害的策略在不对齐时成为福利陷阱，即使对齐也可能锁定延迟危害。

title: 5ting at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Strong End-to-End Multi-Turn RAG via LLM-Based Reranking and Faithfulness Control
summary: We introduce 5ting, our system for the SemEval2026 Task 8 (MTRAGEval), which evaluates multi-turn Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Multi turn RAG involves context drift, under specification, and hallucination risk. Our system combines BGE-M3 dense retrieval with FAISS indexing, dual-query merged retrieval, and LLM based reranking, followed by role separated generation constrained to retrieved evidence. The retriever achieved nDCG@5 = 0.4719 in Task A, while the end to end system ranked in Task C with a harmonic score of 0.5597 and RL_F = 0.7692.

AI.tldr: 提出5ting系统，结合BGE-M3密集检索、FAISS索引、双查询合并检索、LLM重排序和角色分离生成，用于多轮RAG评估，在SemEval2026 Task 8中取得有效结果。
AI.motivation: 多轮RAG存在上下文漂移、查询不明确和幻觉风险等问题，需要更有效的检索与生成系统来提升对话质量。
AI.method: 采用BGE-M3密集检索+FAISS索引进行初步检索，通过双查询合并检索增强召回，结合LLM重排序优化结果，最后使用角色分离生成策略，仅基于检索到的证据进行回答。
AI.result: 检索任务（Task A）nDCG@5=0.4719，端到端系统（Task C）调和得分0.5597，RL_F=0.7692。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多轮RAG系统能够有效应对上下文漂移和幻觉风险，各组件协同工作取得了有竞争力的评估结果。

title: JASPR: Joint Spatial Representation learning of histology and spatial genomics for improved virtual genomic screening and clinical prognostication
summary: Recent studies have shown that spatial properties of tumors are critical for understanding disease biology and predicting patient outcomes. These spatial properties are increasingly uncovered through complementary modalities: spatial transcriptomics (ST) captures spatially-resolved molecular states, while hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole slide images (HE) reveal tissue morphology. While approaches are emerging to fuse these modalities, effective methods that learn not only joint representations but also incorporate spatial context across modalities are lacking. Here, we present JASPR (Joint Spatial Representation learning), a self-supervised deep learning framework that integrates HE images and ST data through a cross-modal reconstruction objective that incorporates spatial context within HE images and ST profiles. It employs shared modules to capture universal spatial properties across modalities, while modality-specific experts encode features unique to morphological and genomic data. We train and validate JASPR on breast cancer datasets, demonstrating that its learned joint representation substantially improves HE-based prediction of 9,248 genes and provides prognostic value for breast cancer outcomes.

AI.tldr: JASPR是一个自监督深度学习框架，通过交叉模态重建目标整合HE组织学图像与空间转录组数据，学习联合空间表征，有效提升基因表达预测和乳腺癌预后评估。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏有效融合空间转录组（ST）和HE组织学图像两种模态、并同时学习联合表征和跨模态空间上下文信息的有效方法。
AI.method: 提出JASPR框架，采用自监督学习、交叉模态重建目标、共享模块捕获通用空间属性、模态特定专家编码各自独有特征。
AI.result: 在乳腺癌数据集上，JASPR学习的联合表征显著提升了基于HE图像对9,248个基因的预测性能，并为乳腺癌预后提供了有价值的指标。
AI.conclusion: JASPR有效融合HE和ST两种模态，验证了整合空间上下文信息对疾病理解和预后预测的重要价值。

title: RadarTwin: Scene-Specific mmWave Radar Simulation and Learning for Mobile Indoor Perception
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar perception is limited by data scarcity: models trained on existing radar datasets fail to generalize to new objects, environments, and sensing trajectories. We present RadarTwin, a framework for generating deployment-specific radar training data before real data collection. Given a 3D reconstruction of a target space (phone LiDAR, robot-mounted sensing, or RGB-to-3D), RadarTwin uses a vision-language model to infer radar-relevant surface materials and a physics-based ray tracer to synthesize raw frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar measurements with multi-bounce propagation. To study what transfers from simulation to reality, we collect a paired real-simulated dataset spanning household objects, material classes, distances, rotations, translations, and mobile sensing trajectories. We show that simulated and real radar share the same object-discriminative shape and material features, and that modeling the environment's multipath is essential to matching real measurements. A representation trained on simulation alone recognizes real objects at 2.5 times chance with no real radar labels, and a few labeled examples raise this to 95.3% on a 12-way recognition task. RadarTwin enables training radar perception for a new space before any real radar data is collected there.

AI.tldr: RadarTwin是一个框架，利用3D重建、视觉语言模型和物理光线追踪器，在真实数据收集之前生成特定部署场景的合成雷达训练数据，使模拟训练的雷达感知模型能够有效迁移到真实场景。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达感知面临数据稀缺问题：基于现有数据集训练的模型无法泛化到新物体、新环境和新传感轨迹，迫切需要一种能在真实数据采集前生成部署特定雷达训练数据的方法。
AI.method: 给定目标空间的3D重建，使用视觉语言模型推断雷达相关表面材料，结合基于物理的光线追踪器合成多跳传播的FMCW雷达测量数据，并构建配对真实-模拟数据集进行跨域迁移验证。
AI.result: 模拟与真实雷达共享相同的物体判别形状和材料特征；纯模拟训练模型在无真实标签下物体识别准确率为随机水平的2.5倍，少量真实标注可达95.3%的12类识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: RadarTwin能在真实雷达数据收集之前为新的部署空间生成有效的雷达感知训练数据，环境多径建模对匹配真实测量至关重要。

title: ComMem: Complementary Memory Systems for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
comment: A brain-inspired complementary memory framework leveraging fast visual caching and slow textual refinement for VLM test-time adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) of vision-language models (VLMs) is essential for their robust deployment in dynamic, real-world environments. However, existing TTA methods often adapt locally without accumulating knowledge over time, or operating within a single modality without exploiting VLMs' inherently multi-modal nature. Inspired by the \textbf{Com}plementary \textbf{Mem}ory systems of the biological brain, we propose \textbf{ComMem}, an innovative approach that mimics the distinct but cooperative roles of the hippocampus and neocortex to enable effective TTA for VLMs. ComMem consists of two key components: a fast-adapting detailed memory, akin to the hippocampus, that forms a dynamic visual cache from high-confidence test samples; and a slow-integrating abstract memory, akin to the neocortex, that continually refines global textual prototypes. For each test instance, ComMem jointly optimizes both memory systems to ensure cross-modal consistency. Extensive experiments on 15 benchmark datasets show that ComMem significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods under both natural distribution shifts and cross-dataset generalization, offering a promising direction for enhancing VLMs' practical adaptability.

AI.tldr: ComMem是一种受生物互补记忆系统启发的视觉语言模型测试时自适应方法，通过快速适应的详细记忆（类似海马体）和缓慢整合的抽象记忆（类似新皮层）的协同工作，在15个基准数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法要么在局部适应过程中无法积累知识，要么仅在单一模态中操作，未能充分利用VLMs固有的多模态特性，导致在动态真实环境中鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 受大脑互补记忆系统启发，提出ComMem方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 快速适应的详细记忆（类似海马体），从高置信度测试样本构建动态视觉缓存；(2) 缓慢整合的抽象记忆（类似新皮层），持续优化全局文本原型。对每个测试样本，联合优化两个记忆系统以保证跨模态一致性。
AI.result: 在15个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ComMem在自然分布偏移和跨数据集泛化两种场景下均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: ComMem为增强视觉语言模型的实际适应性提供了一个有前景的方向，通过模拟生物大脑的互补记忆系统实现了更有效的测试时自适应。

title: Structure-Preserving Document Translation via Multi-Stage LLM Pipeline: A Case Study in Marathi
summary: Government documents in India are predominantly issued in regional languages such as Marathi, creating substantial accessibility barriers for non-native readers, interstate administrative bodies, and policy analysts. Although recent advances in neural machine translation have improved sentence-level translation quality, existing systems largely neglect document structure, formatting integrity, and domain-specific terminology, thereby limiting their applicability to official documentation. This paper presents a structure-preserving Marathi-to-English government document translation framework capable of performing end-to-end document transformation while maintaining layout fidelity. The proposed system integrates layout-aware optical character recognition, coordinate-based text extraction, large language model based translation, and structured document reconstruction through HTML representations. By enforcing spatial alignment constraints and preserving hierarchical document elements, the framework ensures structural consistency between the source and translated documents. Experimental evaluation on real-world Marathi government PDFs demonstrates improved structural preservation, translation coherence, and terminological consistency compared to conventional text-only translation pipelines. The proposed framework contributes toward scalable multilingual accessibility solutions for e-governance and administrative document processing.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向印地语（马拉地语）到英语的政府文档结构保持翻译框架，整合了布局感知OCR、坐标文本提取、大模型翻译和HTML重建，确保翻译后文档的布局与结构完整性。
AI.motivation: 印度政府文档主要使用马拉地语等地区语言发布，对非母语读者和跨行政机构造成严重障碍；现有NMT系统忽视文档结构、格式完整性和领域术语，难以应用于官方文档场景。
AI.method: 集成布局感知OCR、基于坐标的文本提取、大语言模型翻译、通过HTML表示进行结构化文档重建，施加空间对齐约束并保留层级文档元素。
AI.result: 在真实马拉地语政府PDF上实验，相比传统纯文本翻译流水线，在结构保持、翻译连贯性和术语一致性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为电子政务和行政文档处理提供了可扩展的多语言可访问性解决方案。

title: CLOSER-VLN: Closed-Loop Self-Verified Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) has recently advanced with large language and multimodal models, enabling agents to follow natural-language instructions in unseen environments without training a task-specific navigation policy. However, most existing VLN methods relying on large models still adopt an open-loop decision-execution approach, where candidate actions are generated from instructions and observations but are rarely verified or corrected before execution. This causes critical issues in aerial VLN, where minor errors in intermediate actions may quickly accumulate into large trajectory deviations and lead to target loss. To address this issue, we propose Closed-loop Self-verified Retrieval-augmented Reasoning (CLOSER), a training-policy-free method that sequentially performs action reasoning, reliability verification, targeted retrieval, and action correction in a closed-loop manner before executing concrete actions. We instantiate the CLOSER in aerial VLN tasks and develop a CLOSER-VLN framework, which is composed of three components: a hierarchical reasoner for generating candidate actions based on available information, a multidimensional action verifier for assessing the reliability of actions generated by the reasoner, and a verification-triggered multimodal retriever for retrieving targeted exemplars from a memory bank only when verification fails. We conduct experimental evaluations on the CityNav benchmark, where CLOSER-VLN achieves 32.01% SR and 21.28% SPL on the test-unseen split, confirming the effectiveness of closed-loop reasoning.

AI.tldr: CLOSER是一种无需训练策略的闭环自验证检索增强推理方法，通过在执行动作前进行推理、验证、检索和修正的闭环流程，有效解决了空中VLN中中间动作误差累积导致轨迹偏离的问题，在CityNav基准上取得了32.01% SR和21.28% SPL的成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有依赖大模型的VLN方法大多采用开环决策-执行方式，候选动作在生成后很少经过验证或修正，这导致空中VLN中中间动作的微小误差快速累积，造成大的轨迹偏离和目标丢失。
AI.method: 提出CLOSER框架，包含三个组件：分层推理器（基于可用信息生成候选动作）、多维度动作验证器（评估推理器生成动作的可靠性）、验证触发多模态检索器（仅在验证失败时从记忆库检索目标范例），在执行具体动作前以闭环方式依次进行动作推理、可靠性验证、目标检索和动作修正。
AI.result: 在CityNav基准的test-unseen split上，CLOSER-VLN实现了32.01%的成功率（SR）和21.28%的SPL，验证了闭环推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 闭环自验证检索增强推理方法能有效提升空中VLN任务的性能，无需训练任务特定的导航策略。

title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
summary: LLM agents are expected to act over multiple turns, using search, browsing interfaces, and terminal tools to complete user goals. Yet not every goal is well specified or achievable in the available environment. In such cases, a reliable agent should recognize that further interaction is unlikely to help and abstain from additional tool calls. We define Agentic Abstention, the problem of deciding when an agent should stop acting under uncertainty. Unlike standard LLM abstention, which is usually evaluated as a single-turn answer-or-abstain decision, agentic abstention is a sequential decision problem: an agent can answer, abstain, or gather more information at each turn, and the need to abstain may only become clear after interacting with the environment. We study this problem across web shopping, terminal environments, and question answering, evaluating 13 LLM-as-agent systems and 2 agent scaffolds on more than 28,000 tasks. Our results show that the main challenge is not only whether agents can abstain, but also when they abstain. Some agents never abstain when they should, while others do so only after many unnecessary interactions. This gap is especially large on tasks where the instruction appears feasible until the environment reveals otherwise (e.g., no valid result matches the instruction). We further find that model scale, reasoning, and agent scaffolding affect abstention in different ways, where larger or more capable models sometimes perform worse at timely abstention. Finally, we introduce CONVOLVE, a context engineering method for improving agentic abstention that distills full interaction trajectories into reusable stopping rules. On WebShop, CONVOLVE substantially improves timely abstention without updating model parameters, raising Llama-3.3-70B's timely recall rate from 26.7 to 57.4. Our dataset and code are available at https://lhannnn.github.io/agentic-abstention

AI.tldr: 本文定义了“智能体拒绝”（Agentic Abstention）问题——即LLM智能体在多轮交互中应何时停止行动。研究发现，现有智能体要么该拒绝时不拒绝，要么在大量无效交互后才拒绝。作者提出了CONVOLVE方法，通过将完整交互轨迹蒸馏为可复用的停止规则，在不更新模型参数的情况下显著提升了及时拒绝率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM拒绝机制主要关注单轮“回答或拒绝”决策，但在多轮智能体场景（如网页购物、终端操作、问答）中，智能体需要在每个回合决定是回答、拒绝还是继续收集信息。而拒绝的必要性往往只有与环境交互后才能明确，现有方法无法有效处理这种序列决策问题。
AI.method: 1. 定义了Agentic Abstention问题框架；2. 在网页购物、终端环境和问答三个场景上评估了13种LLM-as-agent系统和2种智能体框架，涵盖超过28,000个任务；3. 提出了CONVOLVE方法，将完整交互轨迹蒸馏为可复用的停止规则，用于指导智能体在合适时机停止行动。
AI.result: 1. 主要挑战不仅在于智能体能否拒绝，还在于何时拒绝——有些智能体从未正确拒绝，有些则在大量无效交互后才拒绝；2. 在指令看似可行但环境揭示其不可行的任务上，性能差距尤为显著；3. 模型规模、推理能力和智能体框架对拒绝行为有不同影响，更大或更强的模型有时在及时拒绝上表现更差；4. CONVOLVE在WebShop上将Llama-3.3-70B的及时拒绝召回率从26.7提升至57.4。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在多轮交互中需要更好的及时拒绝机制。CONVOLVE作为一种无需更新模型参数的上下文工程方法，能有效提升智能体在不确定环境下的及时拒绝能力，为构建更可靠的LLM智能体系统提供了新思路。

title: Labeling Training Data for Entity Matching Using Large Language Models
summary:
Recent large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on entity matching without requiring task-specific training data. However, applying these models to large sets of candidate pairs remains slow and costly. In contrast, entity matchers using traditional machine learning methods or small language models (SLMs), such as RoBERTa, offer much faster inference but require task-specific training data.
  This paper investigates whether the need to provide task-specific training data can be avoided by using knowledge-distillation workflows, in which an LLM serves as a teacher model to label training pairs that are subsequently used to train a smaller student model. We investigate knowledge distillation for entity matching along the following dimensions: pair-selection strategy, teacher model, label post-processing method, and student model. We evaluate the workflows using the Abt-Buy, Walmart-Amazon, WDC Products, DBLP-ACM, and DBLP-Scholar benchmarks, and compare the performance of student models trained with machine-labeled data to the performance of the same models trained using the benchmark training sets.
  Our experiments show that student models trained using the machine-labeled sets perform approximately on par with models trained on the benchmark training sets, with the remaining differences in both directions staying below two F1 points. Using GPT-5.2 to label the training sets for all five benchmarks costs US\$28.31 to US\$40.88, whereas manually labeling the same training sets is estimated to require 470 hours of work. At inference time, Ditto is 41.5 to 534 times faster than directly using an LLM to perform the matching tasks.
  These results indicate that current LLMs, when combined with a suitable pair-selection method, can substantially reduce or even eliminate the manual effort required to label use case-specific training data for entity matching.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用知识蒸馏技术，以大型语言模型（LLM）作为教师模型自动标注实体匹配训练数据，训练出与人工标注数据性能相当（F1差异<2点）但推理速度快41.5-534倍的小模型，仅需花费28-41美元即可替代约470小时的人工标注工作。
AI.motivation: LLM在实体匹配任务上表现优异但推理速度慢、成本高，而传统方法和小语言模型速度快但需要大量任务特定训练数据。本文旨在探索能否通过知识蒸馏避免人工标注训练数据的需求。
AI.method: 采用知识蒸馏工作流，LLM作为教师模型标注训练对，训练小型学生模型。系统研究了四个维度：对选择策略、教师模型、标签后处理方法、学生模型。在Abt-Buy等五个基准数据集上评估。
AI.result: 学生模型使用机器标注数据训练，性能与使用基准训练集训练的模型相当，F1差异在2分以内。使用GPT-5.2标注五个数据集仅花费28.31-40.88美元，而人工标注需470小时。Ditto推理速度比直接使用LLM快41.5-534倍。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM结合适当的对选择方法，可以显著减少甚至消除实体匹配任务中人工标注训练数据的工作量，实现高效且经济的实体匹配方案。

title: Semantic-Aware Generative Image Transmission for Resource-Constrained Visual IoT Systems
summary: Resource-constrained visual Internet of Things (IoT) systems, such as edge cameras, unmanned sensing platforms, industrial inspection nodes, and remote monitoring sensors, often need to transmit task-relevant visual evidence over low-rate wireless links to an edge/cloud service. Existing image communication methods usually compress or transmit complete global representations, leaving limited room to exploit receiver-side generative restoration. This paper proposes a semantic-aware generative image transmission framework for edge-assisted visual IoT. The image captured by an IoT visual sensor is encoded into a discrete token grid by a VQ encoder. At the IoT transmitter or nearby gateway, token recoverability, estimated from prediction entropy and local structure complexity, is fused with semantic importance obtained from instance segmentation and category-aware scoring. A spatial dispersal sampler then selects the tokens to be transmitted under a bitrate budget. The transmitter sends only the quantization indices of kept tokens and a binary mask map, while the edge/cloud receiver recovers masked tokens through MaskGIT with Halton sequence scheduling. Experiments on Kodak and VisDrone scenes under AWGN and Rayleigh channels show that the proposed method provides a flexible bitrate-quality tradeoff for narrowband visual IoT links. At 0.074 bpp, it uses 44.6% of the transmitted bits of the 0.167-bpp DeepJSCC/WITT reference while achieving 29.9 dB PSNR. A pseudo-GT downstream detection study on Kodak further shows that semantic-aware masking preserves task-relevant objects better than random masking at both 30% and 50% mask ratios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向边缘辅助视觉物联网的语义感知生成式图像传输框架，通过VQ编码、语义重要性评估和离散采样，在极低码率下实现高质量图像恢复，0.074 bpp下PSNR达29.9 dB。
AI.motivation: 资源受限的视觉物联网系统（如边缘摄像头、无人传感平台等）需在低速率无线链路上传输任务相关的视觉证据，现有方法通常压缩或传输完整全局表示，难以充分利用接收端的生成式恢复能力。
AI.method: 1) VQ编码器将图像编码为离散token网格；2) 结合预测熵和局部结构复杂度估计token可恢复性，融合实例分割和类别评分的语义重要性；3) 空间分散采样器在码率预算下选择token；4) 仅传输保留token的量化索引和二元掩码图；5) 接收端利用MaskGIT和Halton序列调度恢复被掩码的token。
AI.result: 在Kodak和VisDrone数据集上，AWGN和Rayleigh信道下，所提方法在0.074 bpp时仅使用0.167 bpp DeepJSCC/WITT参考方法44.6%的传输比特，达到29.9 dB PSNR。下游检测实验表明，语义感知掩码在30%和50%掩码率下比随机掩码更好保留任务相关物体。
AI.conclusion: 所提语义感知生成式图像传输框架为窄带视觉物联网链路提供了灵活的码率-质量权衡，在极低码率下显著优于现有方法。

title: Agent Safety Is Action Alignment
summary: Large language models increasingly act as agents: they call tools, move money, delete records, and send messages on a user's behalf. To keep them safe, practitioners imported the chatbot-era recipe (train the model to refuse unsafe inputs) into the agentic setting, and treat the resulting capability loss as a manageable ``alignment tax.'' We argue this is a \emph{category error}. Refusal is a primitive for \emph{content safety}, where the harm is in the model's output and is therefore a learnable function of it. Agentic harm is different in kind: it lies not in any output but in the relation between the authority an action exercises and the authority the user granted, which is absent from the text the model sees. Importing content-safety methods into this regime does not trade capability for safety; it pays capability and buys negative security. We support this with three lines of evidence spanning the autonomy spectrum: defense-trained models learn surface patterns rather than intent; the same training collapses multi-step agents before any threat appears while leaving them exploitable; and even undefended frontier models exceed granted authority under ordinary use. We conclude that action safety cannot be installed in weights. It must be expressed as \emph{least privilege}, enforced \emph{outside} the model at the action boundary, and evaluated as \emph{action alignment} (a relational, deployment-conditioned property) rather than a refusal score.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，将聊天机器人时代的“拒绝回答”安全策略直接套用到智能体（agent）场景是“范畴错误”：内容安全关注输出内容本身（可学习），而智能体安全关注行为与用户授权的关系（不可从文本习得）。防御训练不仅牺牲能力，反而购买“负安全”。作者提出行动安全不能被安装进模型权重，而应在行动边界外实施最小权限原则。
AI.motivation: 当前实践中，智能体安全沿用聊天机器人时代的“训练模型拒绝不安全输入”的方法，但这导致能力损失被当作可接受的“对齐税”。作者认为这是一种范畴错误，智能体伤害的本质不在输出内容，而在行为与用户授权的关系，因此需要重新审视安全范式。
AI.method: 通过三条证据链论证：（1）防御训练的模型学习的是表面模式而非真正意图；（2）同一训练在多步智能体场景中在威胁出现前就已导致智能体崩溃，同时仍存在可利用漏洞；（3）即使是未防御的前沿模型，在普通使用中也会超越授权范围。
AI.result: 防御训练并未真正提升智能体安全性，反而以牺牲能力为代价带来虚假的安全感（负安全）。模型无法从文本层面学习到行为与授权之间的约束关系。
AI.conclusion: 行动安全无法被植入模型权重中，必须在模型外部的行动边界上以“最小权限”原则强制执行，并通过“行动对齐”（一种关系性的、依赖部署条件的属性）而非拒绝率来评估。

title: The Heterogeneous Safety Impacts of Benign Multilingual Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a large language model is a ubiquitous method for enhancing its capability on a specific downstream task. However, prior work has shown that this increase in capability comes with a cost: it can increase a model's tendency to respond to unsafe adversarial prompts, even when fine-tuning with non-adversarial data. We present the first comprehensive empirical study of this phenomenon in multilingual settings by fine-tuning Llama-3.2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models using benign data translated across nine languages. We find that safety outcomes are highly sensitive to both the choice of fine-tuning language and the evaluation language, with adversarial compliance rates increasing four-fold in some settings. Multilingual safety drift is decoupled from general capability metrics, and occurs heterogeneously across languages and models. Fine-tuning in non-English languages often induces smaller internal representational drifts than English, but these shifts lead models to default to either exaggerated compliance or refusal. As such, assessing fine-tuning impacts solely in English provides inadequate assurance for deployment. To facilitate further research into these cross-lingual safety blind spots, we release the Multilingual-Benign-Tune dataset and the SORRY-Bench-Multilingual evaluation suite.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了多语言环境下微调大模型（Llama-3.2、Qwen3、Gemma-3）带来的安全偏移问题，发现即使使用良性数据进行微调，模型在非英语语言上的对抗性攻击合规率可提升四倍，且安全漂移与能力指标脱耦，单纯英语评估不足以保障部署安全。
AI.motivation: 以往研究表明微调会降低模型对不安全提示的抵抗力，但这种现象在多语言环境下的表现尚不清楚，因此需要系统研究不同语言微调对模型安全性的影响。
AI.method: 使用九种语言的良性数据对Llama-3.2、Qwen3、Gemma-3进行微调，并在多语言环境下评估模型的安全合规率、内部表征漂移及能力指标变化。
AI.result: 安全结果高度依赖于微调语言和评估语言的选择，某些设置下对抗性合规率提升四倍；多语言安全漂移与通用能力指标脱耦，且在不同语言和模型上呈现异质性；非英语微调诱导的内部表征漂移较小，但会导致模型倾向于过度顺从或过度拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 仅用英语评估微调影响不足以保障多语言部署的安全性，需要关注跨语言安全盲区；为此发布了Multilingual-Benign-Tune数据集和SORRY-Bench-Multilingual评估套件。

title: Meta-learning as a principle for human-like visual representations
summary: The structure of human visual representations underpins our capacity for adaptive behaviour. While pretrained neural networks model human visual representations with unprecedented success, a large discrepancy remains. We propose one reason: these networks optimise a single fixed objective, whereas human representations must support open-ended tasks. We hypothesise this flexibility arises from meta-learning (learning to learn), a pressure shaping representations to acquire new tasks from few observations. To test this, we train a sequence model, without any supervision from human data, across thousands of semantically rich tasks mapping images to high-level concepts. Compared to their pretrained base encoders, meta-learned representations better predict human similarity judgements, semantic rule learning, and high-level visual cortex. Behavioural gains depend on disentangled, high-level task distributions, while brain alignment is driven primarily by the learning-to-learn pressure. Our results suggest the flexibility of human visual representations reflects the functional demand to learn new semantic relationships on the fly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人类视觉表征的灵活性源于元学习（学会学习）的压力，通过在数千个语义丰富的任务上训练序列模型，证明了元学习得到的表征相比预训练模型能更好地预测人类相似性判断、语义规则学习及高级视觉皮层活动。
AI.motivation: 预训练神经网络与人类视觉表征之间存在较大差距，原因是网络优化单一固定目标，而人类表征需要支持开放性任务，这种灵活性可能源于元学习。
AI.method: 训练一个序列模型，在数千个将图像映射到高层概念的语义丰富任务上进行元学习，不使用任何人类数据的监督信号。
AI.result: 相比预训练基编码器，元学习表征更好地预测人类相似性判断、语义规则学习和高级视觉皮层活动。行为增益依赖于解缠的高层任务分布，而脑对齐主要由学习到学习的压力驱动。
AI.conclusion: 人类视觉表征的灵活性反映了一种功能性需求：即需要即时学习新的语义关系。

title: Self-Supervised Theorem Discovery in a Formal Axiomatic System
summary: Recent artificial intelligence (AI) systems have shown remarkable progress in mathematical reasoning. Many existing approaches, including large language models (LLMs), draw on human prior knowledge in the form of mathematical text, code, or theorem libraries. Although these approaches are highly effective in practice, it remains an open question whether an agent can autonomously discover useful theorems without such human priors. We study this question in a formal axiomatic system by developing an agent that starts from axioms and inference rules alone and gradually grows a library of useful theorems. Concretely, we propose a self-supervised theorem-discovery algorithm that alternates between proof search and useful-theorem extraction, building a theorem library whose entries are reused as lemmas for subsequent proof search. Experiments show that the agent discovers tens of thousands of theorems and finds proofs for human-written benchmark problems, suggesting that its discoveries include theorems meaningful from a human mathematical perspective. Furthermore, the discovered theorems improve LLM proof performance when provided as prompt lemmas, indicating that they can serve as external knowledge for LLM reasoning. Our results provide evidence that useful theorems can emerge from proof search without relying on human-provided theorem libraries. More broadly, they suggest a path toward self-evolving AI systems for mathematics whose discoveries remain formally verifiable.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需人类先验知识的自监督定理发现算法，该算法通过交替进行证明搜索和有用定理提取，从公理和推理规则出发自主构建定理库，实验表明该算法能发现数万个定理并提升LLM的证明性能。
AI.motivation: 探究智能体是否能在没有人类先验知识（如数学文本、代码或定理库）的情况下，在形式化公理系统中自主发现有用的定理。
AI.method: 提出一种自监督定理发现算法，交替进行证明搜索和有用定理提取，逐步构建定理库，并将库中条目作为引理复用于后续证明搜索。
AI.result: 智能体发现了数万个定理，成功证明了人类编写的基准问题，且发现的定理作为提示引理时能提升LLM的证明性能。
AI.conclusion: 有用定理可以从证明搜索中涌现，无需依赖人类提供的定理库，暗示了通向自我进化的AI数学系统的路径。

title: Open but Incompatible: A License Compatibility Analysis of Corpora for Low-Resource African Languages
comment: 12 pages. Published in Proceedings of Resources for African Indigenous Languages (RAIL) 2026 @ LREC-COLING 2026, pages 128-139
summary: Creative Commons licenses dominate African NLP corpus releases, but their compatibility rules are rarely applied. CC-BY-SA and CC-BY-NC cannot be combined in a single published dataset; a NoDerivs clause silently prohibits tokenisation and annotation. This paper audits the license provenance of over twenty corpus families used in African NLP, constructs a six-tier compatibility matrix, and applies it to three case-study languages: Kituba/Munukutuba, Zarma, and Moore. Four failure modes are documented with primary-source evidence: outright prohibition (JW300, removed from OPUS after a legal audit confirmed Terms of Service violation); composite license misrepresentation (WAXAL, whose CC-BY 4.0 claim is contradicted by its own HuggingFace dataset card); a NoDerivs clause hidden behind a CC-BY label (Tanzil); and data persistence failure (the Congolese Radio Corpus, where 402 of 405 source URLs are now dead). A pre-annotation due diligence checklist and a survey of legally clean enrichment opportunities close the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了非洲NLP领域超过20个语料库家族的许可证来源，揭示了CC许可证兼容性规则被普遍忽视的问题（如CC-BY-SA和CC-BY-NC不能混合发布，NoDerivs条款禁止分词和标注），并通过三种语言案例（基图巴语/穆努库图巴语、扎尔马语、莫西语）展示了四种许可证失效模式（完全禁止、混合许可误标、隐藏的NoDerivs条款、数据持久性失败），最后提供了预标注尽职检查清单和合法数据增强方案。
AI.motivation: 非洲NLP领域的语料库发布广泛使用CC许可证，但许可证兼容性规则几乎未被遵守，可能导致法律风险和构建的模型面临合规问题，需要系统性审计和明确指导。
AI.method: 审计了20多个语料库家族的许可证来源，构建了一个六层兼容性矩阵，并以Kituba/Munukutuba、Zarma、Moore三种语言为案例进行深入分析，结合主要来源证据记录四种失效模式。
AI.result: 发现了四种许可证失效模式：1) JW300因违反服务条款从OPUS移除；2) WAXAL标注CC-BY 4.0但HuggingFace数据卡显示矛盾；3) Tanzil在CC-BY标签下隐藏了NoDerivs条款；4) Congolese Radio Corpus中402/405条源URL已失效。
AI.conclusion: 非洲NLP社区需要重视CC许可证的兼容性规则，论文提供了预标注尽职检查清单和合法数据增强方案作为解决方案。

title: Mechanistic Personality Analysis of LLMs Steering Personality via Latent Feature Interventions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to simulate human-like OCEAN personality traits in generated text. Previous efforts have focused on prompt engineering or fine-tuning to shape LLM personality. In this work, we propose a mechanistic interpretability approach that directly intervenes on the model's latent features. Our method identifies latent directions in the residual stream corresponding to a target OCEAN trait using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and contrastive activation analysis. We formalize an additive steering vector in activation space and demonstrate how applying a small additive shift to the hidden states enhances the target trait while preserving overall language modeling performance. To determine the optimal combination of feature shifts, we explore a linear weighting heuristic with grid search optimization that balances personality expression with task performance. Our approach shows promise in controllably steering personality traits at the mechanistic level while maintaining high performance on standard benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于稀疏自编码器和对比激活分析的机械可解释性方法，通过在残差流中识别与OCEAN人格特质对应的潜在方向并施加加法转向向量，实现对LLM人格特质的可控操纵，同时保持语言建模性能。
AI.motivation: 现有塑造LLM人格的方法主要依赖提示工程或微调，缺乏对模型内部机制的深入理解和可控性。作者希望从机械可解释性层面直接干预潜在特征，实现更精细的人格控制。
AI.method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）和对比激活分析，在残差流中识别与目标OCEAN特质对应的潜在方向；形式化定义激活空间中的加法转向向量；通过网格搜索优化线性加权启发式，平衡人格表达与任务性能。
AI.result: 该方法能在机械层面可控地操纵人格特质，同时保持标准基准测试的高性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于机械可解释性的潜在特征干预为LLM人格控制提供了新途径，比传统方法更具可解释性和可控性。

title: Memory-Managed Long-Context Attention: A Preliminary Study of Editable Request-Local Memory
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Preliminary technical report
summary: Long-context language models often conflate two different goals: compressing history into an efficient state, and maintaining reliable long-term memory. Linear, recurrent, and sparse attention reduce the cost of processing long sequences, but they do not by themselves specify when a fact should be written, overwritten, protected from distractors, or discarded. We study memory-managed long-context attention, a research route that separates a fast recurrent or sparse backbone from explicit editable request-local memory slots and query-time sparse fallback. Across structured synthetic tasks, token/chunk/sequence bridges, generated natural language, and local frozen-model diagnostics, pure fixed-state or pure sparse methods fail some overwrite, version, anti-pollution, or no-write-signal cases, while a hybrid covers both routes. A small 2,097,152-token mechanism stress test reaches 50/50 pooled accuracy with 2-132 active chunks. A 2.74M-parameter minimal causal event-token model reaches 595/600 with lite write supervision, supporting proof of trainability rather than scale. A six-family frozen-hidden-state bridge reaches 1079/1080 controlled pointer accuracy, but it uses generator-provided integer key IDs and separately encoded canonical key strings; it is an oracle-metadata probe, not open-text entity resolution. Local non-leaderboard RULER 4K diagnostics remain close to full context, whereas a 33-record LongBench v1 16K subset shows that naive lexical selection is not general. The evidence separates three claims: controlled slot lifecycle is feasible, sparse fallback is needed when writes lack future-query signals, and learned open-domain selection remains the main architectural bottleneck. We do not claim a final generative architecture, global slot-trajectory convergence, or systems superiority.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了记忆管理的长上下文注意力机制，提出将快速循环/稀疏主干网络与可编辑的请求局部记忆槽和查询时稀疏回退相结合，以解决长上下文模型在历史压缩与长期记忆之间的冲突。实验表明，纯固定状态或纯稀疏方法在覆盖、版本、抗污染等任务上失败，而混合方法能覆盖两条路线。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型常混淆两个不同目标：将历史压缩为高效状态 vs. 维护可靠的长期记忆。现有线性、循环和稀疏注意力虽降低了长序列处理成本，但未明确指定何时写入、覆盖、保护或丢弃事实。
AI.method: 提出记忆管理的长上下文注意力（Memory-Managed Long-Context Attention），将快速的循环/稀疏主干网络与显式的可编辑请求局部记忆槽及查询时稀疏回退分离。通过结构化合成任务、token/chunk/sequence桥接、生成的自然语言和局部冻结模型诊断进行评估。
AI.result: 纯固定状态或纯稀疏方法在覆盖、版本、抗污染和无写入信号案例上失败，而混合方法可覆盖两条路线。2M token压力测试中，2-132个活跃chunk达到50/50聚合准确率；2.74M参数最小因果事件token模型在有轻量写入监督下达到595/600准确率；六家族冻结隐藏状态桥接达1079/1080受控指针准确率。
AI.conclusion: 分离出三个主张：受控槽生命周期可行，当写入缺乏未来查询信号时需要稀疏回退，学习型开放域选择仍是主要架构瓶颈。不声称最终生成架构、全局槽轨迹收敛或系统优越性。

title: HyphaeDB: A Living Knowledge Topology for Agent-First Memory
summary: Every existing vector database and agent memory framework treats memory as passive storage that agents query explicitly. No system propagates knowledge between agents through the memory layer itself.
