AI.method: 提出SJS框架，包含角色分解、类型化角色间通信、密封溯源读取、版本化存储、局部提升等条件。Agora系统用5类LLM智能体通过3通道通信，8个技能库进化，3个评估者产生分歧报告，不投票而聚合。
AI.result: CSI 1000上100轮实验，91天2026年holdout集上Sharpe +1.87；最优基线+1.334（有利种子），跨种子均值-0.755；消融实验仅恢复+0.40的Sharpe差距，PPO加无库进化反而恶化。
AI.conclusion: SJS框架能有效防止联合搜索的自我确认坍塌，两个指标是涌现而非设计产物。局限：单种子运行、信号集中于空头端、适用于多空策略。

title: Knowing in Advance When an Evolutionary Outer Loop Will Not Help: A Pre-Registered Cheap-Baseline Screening Rule
summary: We introduce a pre-registered screening rule that decides, before any implementation, whether an evolutionary / population / lifecycle outer loop over neural-network parameters or structure is worth building. Such outer loops cost 10^2-10^3x their gradient inner loop, yet whether they beat a cheap single-shot alternative is usually discovered only after the expense is paid. Our rule computes, at a Phase-0 gate, a single number: the recovery R = s/G, the best single-shot gradient/curvature statistic's gain s divided by the best gain G of any cheap method evaluated, and prescribes skipping the outer loop when R >= 90%. We validate the rule on a within-lab series of pre-registered outer-loop bets (two analyzed cases plus a disclosed file drawer): in both analyzed cases a static or single-shot computation captured the effect on the project's own metric, the gate fired (R approximately 1.0 in both cases; approximately 0.95 under a stricter metric on one), and the outer loop was abandoned, including one case where a companion factorial decomposition localizes the apparent win to a static substrate change with the evolutionary lifecycle contributing no detectable gain. On one project the gate cost about 50-70 GPU-hours and screened out an estimated 400+ GPU-hours (first cell only) plus weeks of implementation, a 6-8x saving. The rule is prospectively falsifiable: a task with R < 90% where the outer loop still fails to beat single-shot would refute it.

AI.tldr: 提出一种预注册筛选规则R=s/G，在进化/种群外循环实施前评估其必要性。当R≥90%时跳过外循环，可节省6-8倍计算成本。通过两个预注册案例验证，该规则可证伪。
AI.motivation: 进化/种群/生命周期外循环（对神经网络参数或结构）的成本比梯度内循环高10^2-10^3倍，但通常只有在投入大量资源后才发现是否优于廉价的一次性替代方案。因此需要在实施前进行预筛选。
AI.method: 提出Phase-0门控，计算恢复率R = s/G，其中s为最佳单次梯度/曲率统计量的增益，G为任何廉价方法的最佳增益。当R≥90%时跳过外循环。在两个预注册的外循环赌注案例中验证。
AI.result: 两个分析案例中R均约为1.0（更严格指标下约0.95），门控触发，外循环被放弃。其中一个案例通过析因分解发现收益来自静态基底变化，进化生命周期无贡献。一个项目门控成本50-70 GPU小时，筛除了400+GPU小时，节省6-8倍。
AI.conclusion: 该规则可前瞻性证伪：若R<90%但外循环仍未能超过单次方法，则规则被反驳。为是否构建高成本外循环提供了可量化的预注册决策依据。

title: Physics-Grounded Disentangled Flow Modeling for Brain Disease Progression Trajectory
summary: Forecasting longitudinal brain lesion evolution is critical for disease monitoring and treatment planning. Existing approaches typically learn a direct mapping from a baseline image to a future observation, without explicitly modeling the physical mechanisms underlying the lesion progression. Such an entangled modeling of structural deformation and image intensity variation limits physical plausibility, model generalization, and interpretability. To address this, we propose PDF, a Physics-grounded Disentangled Flow matching framework for longitudinal brain disease forecasting. We explicitly decompose the longitudinal modeling of lesion growth into two processes, each learned by a dedicated flow matching network: morphology evolution, which captures lesion growth and structural deformation; and intensity evolution, which models signal changes driven by variations in lesion concentration. To enforce physics-grounded constraints, we introduce a PDE-regularized loss based on lesion growth dynamics, that enforces a diffusion-reaction-advection formulation for morphological evolution. Experiments on three public longitudinal datasets spanning diverse brain diseases demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of the disentangled modeling framework and physics-grounded learning design. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jhuldr/PDF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDF框架，通过物理引导的解耦流匹配模型将脑病变进展分解为形态演化与强度演化两个过程，在三个公开数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接将基线图像映射到未来观察，未显式建模病变进展的物理机制，导致物理合理性、泛化性和可解释性不足。
AI.method: 提出PDF框架，将病变进展解耦为形态演化（捕捉结构变形）和强度演化（建模信号变化），分别用流匹配网络学习，并引入基于病变生长动力学的PDE正则化损失（扩散-反应-平流方程）。
AI.result: 在三种脑疾病的三个公开纵向数据集上取得SOTA性能，验证了解耦建模和物理约束设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的解耦流匹配框架能更合理地建模脑病变时间演化，提升预测的物理可解释性与性能。

title: A Cognition-Emotion-Personality Framework for Modeling Human-Like Awareness and Behavior in Emergency Evacuations
summary: Agent-based evacuation simulations are widely used to study crowd behavior during emergencies, but many models rely on assumptions such as perfect event awareness, complete exit knowledge, and fully rational decision-making. This paper presents an extended evacuation framework that integrates cognitive, emotional, social, and personality-related mechanisms into a unified model of human behavior under uncertainty. The framework incorporates a dynamic event-awareness mechanism based on a continuous Event Certainty Level, a memory-based representation of exit knowledge subject to acquisition, forgetting, and recall, a continuous fear model in which panic emerges as a high-intensity state, and an OCEAN-based personality representation. Neuroticism is explicitly integrated into the emotional model, influencing fear generation, escalation, social contagion, and recovery. Behavioral heterogeneity is further captured through individualized decision thresholds that affect responses to perceived risk. The framework is evaluated through simulation experiments examining the effects of spatial familiarity, memory robustness, decision sensitivity, emotional dynamics, and personality variation. Results show that cognitive, emotional, and personality-driven processes substantially influence evacuation dynamics, reducing evacuation efficiency and generating realistic crowd phenomena such as delays, confusion, injuries, and socially influenced behaviors. The proposed framework provides a more realistic representation of human behavior in emergency evacuations and supports systematic investigation of the interactions between cognition, emotion, personality, and crowd dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个整合认知、情感、社会与人格机制的扩展型疏散仿真框架，通过事件感知、记忆、恐惧模型和OCEAN人格（尤其神经质）来模拟不确定性下的人类行为。实验表明，这些因素显著影响疏散效率，产生延迟、混乱、受伤等真实人群现象。
AI.motivation: 现有疏散仿真模型多基于完美事件感知、完全出口知识、完全理性决策等理想假设，缺乏对认知、情感和人格因素的考虑，难以真实反映紧急情况下的人类行为。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，包含动态事件感知机制（连续事件确定性水平）、基于记忆的出口知识表示（获取、遗忘、回忆）、连续恐惧模型（恐慌作为高激活状态）、OCEAN人格模型（神经质融入情感模型的恐惧生成、升级、社会传染与恢复），以及个体化决策阈值。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，认知、情感和人格驱动的过程显著影响疏散动力学，降低疏散效率，并产生延迟、困惑、受伤和社会影响行为等真实人群现象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了更真实的紧急疏散中人类行为表示，支持系统研究认知、情感、人格与人群动力学的交互作用。

title: How Anthropomorphic Language Impacts Public Perceptions of AI
summary: Public discourse about artificial intelligence (AI) often uses anthropomorphic language: language that attributes human capabilities and characteristics to the system. This practice has been criticized for setting misleading expectations, inflating claims, and fueling hype around AI, which may distort public understanding of AI and impact policy priorities. We study the effects of anthropomorphic framing by comparing changes in participants' perceptions (N=815) when reading passages with and without anthropomorphic language, designed to reflect realistic public-facing AI discourse. We further examine whether these effects differ across two types of AI technologies -- large language models and recommendation systems -- and measure changes in perceptions of AI across several dimensions that are prominent in current public discourse. In a separate condition using a text that explicitly discusses the dangers of AI, we show that individuals' views of AI can shift in response to reading a text; yet in the main conditions of the experiment, where we compare anthropomorphic and non-anthropomorphic descriptions, we find that whether the text uses anthropomorphic language does not substantially affect participants' perceptions of AI. Our results indicate that any immediate effects on public opinions of AI are modest, although they leave open the possibility that anthropomorphic language could have an effect in naturalistic settings, or over gradual, continued exposure.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验（N=815）发现，拟人化语言对公众AI认知的直接影响有限，但明确讨论AI危险性的文本能显著改变看法。
AI.motivation: 公共话语中普遍使用拟人化语言描述AI，可能引发公众对AI的误解、夸大宣传和炒作，影响公众对AI的理解和政策优先级。先前对此现象的批评缺乏实验证据，因此需要系统研究拟人化框架对公众认知的实际影响。
AI.method: 采用在线实验（N=815），比较参与者阅读包含/不包含拟人化语言的AI描述后认知变化。实验覆盖两种AI技术（大型语言模型和推荐系统），并设置了明确讨论AI危险性的对照组，测量多个维度的AI感知变化。
AI.result: 在主要实验条件下，拟人化与非拟人化文本对参与者AI认知无显著差异。但明确讨论AI危险的文本能显著改变人们对AI的看法。拟人化语言在自然情境或长期持续接触下可能存在潜在影响。
AI.conclusion: 拟人化语言对公众AI认知的即时影响微弱，但其在自然环境中或长期累积接触下可能仍有影响，提示未来研究需关注更真实场景和长期效应。

title: AEGIR: Modeling Area Emitters for Indoor Inverse Rendering using Gaussian Splatting
summary: Inverse rendering requires separating illumination from surface materials, which is highly ambiguous due to their tight coupling in observed images. While Gaussian Splatting is efficient for novel view synthesis, existing relightable methods approximate scene lighting using discrete point lights, global environment maps, or implicit representations. By ignoring the physical spatial extent of real-world emitters, these approaches produce incorrect light attenuation and unrealistic shadows. We present AEGIR (Area Emitters for Gaussian Inverse Rendering), a framework that explicitly models local area emitters within a relightable Gaussian Splatting representation. Joint optimization of emitters, materials, and geometry is challenging due to flexible emitter parameterization, which increases both the number of parameters and the ambiguity between illumination and materials. We address this by introducing a differentiable deferred rendering pipeline that integrates multiple importance sampling with targeted regularization. As a result, AEGIR accurately simulates local light transport and achieves more consistent decomposition. Experiments show that explicit area emitters improve illumination reconstruction and enhance downstream tasks, including novel view synthesis, controlled relighting, and virtual object insertion, particularly in scenes with complex local lighting.

AI.tldr: AEGIR通过在可重光照的高斯泼溅表示中显式建模局部区域光源，并引入可微分延迟渲染流水线结合多重重要性采样与正则化，实现了更准确的照明-材质分解，尤其在复杂局部光照场景中显著提升了新视角合成、可控重光照和虚拟物体插入等下游任务的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有可重光照高斯泼溅方法将场景光照近似为点光源、全局环境图或隐式表示，忽略了真实世界光源的物理空间范围，导致错误的光衰减和不真实的阴影。
AI.method: 提出AEGIR框架，在可重光照高斯泼溅表示中显式建模局部区域光源；设计可微分延迟渲染流水线，结合多重重要性采样和针对性正则化，联合优化光源、材质和几何。
AI.result: 显式区域光源改善了光照重建质量；在复杂局部光照场景中，新视角合成、可控重光照和虚拟物体插入等下游任务性能显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模区域光源能够更准确地模拟局部光传输，实现更一致的照明-材质分解，提升逆渲染的整体效果。

title: PolicyGuard: A Dialogue-Grounded Sub-Agent Verifier for Policy Adherence in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents handle user requests on behalf of organizations through tool calls and must follow the company policies stated in their system prompts. Prior work approaches this as a safeguarding problem -- external checks that block non-compliant agent actions. We argue that policy adherence is a broader problem: real workflows unfold across many turns, require explicit user confirmation and prerequisite reads, and hinge on the content of the dialogue rather than on any single argument value. Meeting this bar requires (i) full conversation context, (ii) self-reasoning over the policy and the current dialogue, and (iii) conversation-specific remediation that guides the agent's next turn -- three capabilities that prior safeguard work has often underestimated. We introduce POLICYGUARD, a sub-agent verifier that shares the agent's view of the dialogue, reasons over the policy in context, and provides actionable feedback for the agent's next turn. On tau^2-BENCH airline across three vendors (GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro) with four trials per setting, POLICYGUARD improves PASS4 by +12.0 / +6.0 / +12.0 pp. Per-call analyses show POLICYGUARD achieves higher policy-violation recall while blocking roughly half as often as argument-level guards.

AI.tldr: 提出POLICYGUARD，一个通过共享对话上下文、自主策略推理和对话级修复建议来增强LLM代理策略合规性的子代理验证器，在tau²-BENCH基准测试上相比基线方法提升了12个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将策略遵守视为外部安全检查问题，但真实工作流程涉及多轮对话、需要用户确认和先决条件阅读，且合规性取决于对话内容而非单一参数值，现有方法难以满足这一要求。
AI.method: 提出POLICYGUARD子代理验证器，具备三项核心能力：(i)完整对话上下文感知，(ii)对策略和当前对话的自主推理，(iii)生成对话级别的具体修复建议，指导代理下一轮行动。
AI.result: 在tau²-BENCH航空领域基准上，对GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Pro三个供应商进行四轮测试，POLICYGUARD将PASS4分别提升+12.0/+6.0/+12.0个百分点，策略违规召回率更高，且阻止频率仅为参数级守卫的一半。
AI.conclusion: 策略遵守需要超越参数级检查的全对话上下文推理和具体修复建议，POLICYGUARD通过子代理验证器的方式有效提升了LLM代理在复杂多轮对话中的策略合规性。

title: DistilledGemma: Balanced Efficiency-Accuracy for Person-Place Relation Extraction from Multilingual Historical Articles
comment: The Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF) 2026 - HIPE Challenge
summary: We present DistilledGemma, an efficient and accurate system for the HIPE-2026 shared task on person-place relation extraction from multilingual historical newspaper articles in English, German, and French. Our approach adopts a three-stage knowledge distillation pipeline designed to balance classification accuracy with computational efficiency. In the first stage, we systematically explored prompt engineering strategies across eight large language models to identify the most effective reasoning architecture for this challenging task. In the second stage, we applied supervised fine-tuning (SFT) via QLoRA to a Gemma 4 26B A4B teacher model, leveraging its strong multilingual capabilities to generate silver-standard chain-of-thought traces across the training corpus. In the final stage, we performed response-level distillation to transfer these learned reasoning patterns into a compact Gemma 4 E2B student model. In the official evaluation, our team WHEREAMI ranked 3rd on the standard test set with an accuracy profile mean score of 0.688, and 2nd on the binary test set with a mean score of 0.8156. Notably, by distilling knowledge from the 26B teacher to the 2.3B student, we preserved strong reasoning capabilities while reducing the deployed model size to approximately 2.3B effective parameters; the LoRA adapters used during training were merged into the student for inference. This configuration ranked 2nd in the balanced efficiency-accuracy profile across both the standard and binary test sets. These results demonstrate that knowledge distillation provides a practical and scalable solution for historical document processing, achieving competitive performance without excessive computational cost.

AI.tldr: DistilledGemma通过三阶段知识蒸馏管道（提示工程→教师SFT→响应级蒸馏），将26B参数的Gemma教师模型压缩为2.3B学生模型，在HIPE-2026多语言历史报纸关系抽取任务上取得标准集第3、二值集第2的成绩，并兼顾效率与准确性。
AI.motivation: 在多语言历史报纸中抽取人物-地点关系具有挑战性，现有大模型计算成本高，需在保持精度的同时降低部署开销。
AI.method: 三阶段知识蒸馏：(1) 在8个大语言模型上探索提示工程策略；(2) 用QLoRA对Gemma 4 26B教师模型进行监督微调，生成链式思维伪标签；(3) 响应级蒸馏将推理模式迁移至2.3B的Gemma 4学生模型，LoRA适配器合并用于推理。
AI.result: 标准测试集准确率均值0.688（第3名），二值测试集0.8156（第2名）；效率-精度平衡排名第2；模型从26B压缩至2.3B有效参数。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏为历史文档处理提供了可扩展的实用方案，能在显著降低计算成本的同时保持竞争力。

title: Obliviate: Erasing Concepts from Autoregressive Image Generation Models
summary: The widespread adoption of generative AI models has intensified concerns about misuse, including the creation of unsafe or disturbing imagery. To mitigate such issues, several concept erasure approaches have been proposed to remove harmful content from multimodal generative models. Yet concept erasure for autoregressive image generation remains largely unexplored, despite the growing relevance of these models in recent trends toward unified multimodal architectures. In this work, we fill this gap by introducing Obliviate, a guidance-based concept erasure method for autoregressive image generation. Our method builds on three key design choices: KL-based supervision over visual token distributions, trajectory-level updates over full autoregressive rollouts, and aligned visual prefixes for stable target construction. We evaluate Obliviate on three state-of-the-art autoregressive text-to-image models, Liquid, Emu3-Gen, and Janus-Pro, covering the erasure of explicit content, graphic violence, and branded imagery. Obliviate consistently outperforms current alternatives, reducing nudity on the defensive RAB benchmark from 91.58 to 3.15 while preserving overall model utility.

AI.tldr: 提出Obliviate方法，通过KL监督、轨迹级更新和对齐视觉前缀三种设计，将自回归图像生成中的有害概念擦除成功率提升至3.15（RAB基准），同时保持模型可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法主要针对扩散模型，而自回归图像生成模型（如Liquid、Emu3-Gen、Janus-Pro）的概念擦除尚未被充分研究，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出Obliviate方法，包含三个关键设计：1）基于KL散度的视觉token分布监督；2）对整个自回归生成轨迹的更新；3）对齐视觉前缀用于稳定目标构建。
AI.result: 在三种自回归T2I模型上，Obliviate在显式内容、暴力图像、品牌图像擦除任务中一致优于现有方法，RAB防御基准上裸体内容从91.58降至3.15。
AI.conclusion: Obliviate有效填补了自回归图像生成模型概念擦除的研究空白，在保持模型整体效用的同时大幅降低有害内容生成风险。

title: SurgVLA-Bench: Towards Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Models for Laparoscopic Surgical Robotics
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a promising direction for embodied intelligence in surgical robotics. Despite the prevalence of VLA benchmarks for general robotics, standardized evaluation platforms specifically designed for surgical contexts remain absent. To address this limitation, we present SurgVLA-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLA models in laparoscopic surgical robotics. Leveraging the SurRoL simulation platform, we construct a hierarchical task taxonomy ranging from atomic actions to complete surgical procedures, complemented by a multi-dimensional evaluation framework assessing action accuracy and semantic consistency. We then systematically evaluate two representative paradigms, including autoregressive models such as OpenVLA, and flow matching models such as $π_{0}$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA. Our experiments show that autoregressive models tend to excel in semantic understanding, while flow matching models often achieve higher task precision but may face generalization trade-offs. However, even the best-performing models remain far from satisfactory, as the constrained endoscopic field of view, restricted viewing angles, and frequent occlusions persist as fundamental physical bottlenecks. The code and data are available at https://github.com/VCL-HNU/SurgVLA

AI.tldr: SurgVLA-Bench是首个针对腹腔镜手术机器人的VLA评估基准，基于SurRoL仿真平台构建层次化任务体系，发现自回归模型语义理解强，流匹配模型任务精度高，但整体性能因内镜视野限制而远未达标。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA基准主要针对通用机器人领域，缺乏专门面向手术机器人场景的标准化评估平台，因此需要构建一个针对腹腔镜手术环境的VLA模型评估基准。
AI.method: 基于SurRoL仿真平台构建从原子动作到完整手术流程的层次化任务分类体系，并设计多维评估框架衡量动作准确性和语义一致性。系统评估了两类代表性VLA范式：自回归模型（如OpenVLA）和流匹配模型（如π₀, π₀.₅, SmolVLA）。
AI.result: 自回归模型在语义理解方面表现更优，而流匹配模型在任务精度上更高但存在泛化权衡。然而，所有模型均远未达到满意水平，内镜视野受限、视角限制和频繁遮挡仍然是根本性的物理瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: SurgVLA-Bench填补了手术机器人VLA评估的空白，揭示了当前VLA模型在该场景下的不足，并指出内镜视野等物理限制是未来需要克服的关键挑战。

title: FedLAS: Feature-Modulated Bidirectional Label Smoothing for Neural Network Calibration
summary: Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers suffer from poor calibration when their softmax outputs (predictive confidence) deviate from the empirical likelihoods. This manifests itself as either overconfident incorrect predictions or under-confident correct predictions. Label smoothing (LS) enhances model calibration by introducing entropy regularization during training through redistributing probability mass from the ground-truth label to the remaining classes. LS, including Margin-based LS (MbLS), have restrictive assumptions: they rely on predefined, uniform smoothing rules and only tackle overconfidence. In reality, samples exhibit diverse characteristics, such as difficulty/ambiguity, that interact with the evolving nature of the model being trained. In training, samples may have various degrees of under- or overconfidence. To overcome this, a mechanism that identifies the specific confidence state of each sample and determines the appropriate degree of smoothing in each training step is needed, tailoring the adjustment to the individual sample. We propose FedLAS: Feature-Modulated Bidirectional Label Smoothing, a plug-and-play algorithm for label smoothing-based losses. In FedLAS, we introduce a Feature Norm-based Confidence Indicator (NCI) to control smoothing and a Bidirectional Calibration Gating (BCG) module to detect both over and under-confidence. Our algorithm can be integrated with LS and MbLS based losses when applied to standard DNNs, enhancing performance. Extensive experiments on standard and fine-grained high-resolution vision benchmarks show that FedLAS consistently improves calibration compared to modern baselines, reducing Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Adaptive ECE while maintaining Top-1 accuracy. Code: github.com/nadarasarbahavan/FEDLAS

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedLAS算法，通过特征模长置信度指标和双向校准门控机制，实现样本自适应的双向标签平滑，同时解决模型过自信和欠自信问题，显著提升校准性能。
AI.motivation: 现有标签平滑方法（如LS、MbLS）采用预定义的统一平滑规则，仅能处理过自信问题，无法适应样本的多样性特征（如难易度）以及模型训练过程中的动态变化，且忽略了欠自信问题。
AI.method: 提出FedLAS算法，包含两个核心模块：1）基于特征模长的置信度指标（NCI）控制平滑程度；2）双向校准门控（BCG）模块同时检测过自信和欠自信状态，实现样本级别的自适应双向标签平滑。
AI.result: 在标准和高分辨率细粒度视觉基准上，FedLAS在保持Top-1准确率的同时，持续降低了期望校准误差（ECE）和自适应ECE，优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedLAS作为一种即插即用的标签平滑增强算法，能有效集成到LS和MbLS损失中，通过样本自适应的双向校准提升DNN分类器的校准性能。

title: When Summaries Distort Decisions: Information Fidelity in LLM-Compressed Financial Analysis
summary: Financial decision-makers face more information than they can directly inspect, making context compression necessary. Yet when large language models (LLMs) compress financial source material, they can alter the investment judgment supported by the original source. We frame this problem as information fidelity: compression loses fidelity when it changes the decision induced by the source. In agentic systems, such losses may recur across intermediate steps and amplify throughout the decision process. Across financial filings and earnings-call transcripts, we find that LLM-based compression can produce fluent and factually plausible compressed contexts that nevertheless alter downstream decisions. We analyze two diagnostic patterns associated with fidelity loss: decontextualization, where salient evidence is retained but separated from the caveats and contextual qualifiers needed for correct interpretation, and model dependency, where different compressors expose different views of the same source. We then propose Agentic Context Compression, which generates multiple candidate compressions and audits their disagreements against the original source. Our results suggest that financial compression should be evaluated not only by efficiency or factuality, but also by its ability to preserve decision-relevant context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“信息保真度”概念，指出LLM在压缩金融文本时可能改变投资决策依据，并发现两种保真度损失模式（去语境化与模型依赖性），最后提出多候选压缩与原始源比对审计的智能体压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 金融决策者面临信息过载，需要压缩，但LLM压缩可能改变原始资料所支持的投资判断，现有方法缺乏对决策保真度的评估。
AI.method: 定义信息保真度框架，识别去语境化与模型依赖性两种诊断模式，提出Agentic Context Compression方法：生成多个候选压缩，与原始源进行不一致性审计。
AI.result: LLM压缩可产生流畅、事实合理的文本，却改变下游决策；去语境化与模型依赖性是保真度损失的关键模式。
AI.conclusion: 金融压缩评估不应仅看效率或事实准确性，还应衡量其对决策相关上下文的保持能力。

title: Understanding Evaluation Illusion in Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Despite the capability of parallel decoding, diffusion large language models (dLLMs) require many denoising steps to maintain generation quality, motivating recent research on efficient decoding strategies. However, existing studies have reported inconsistent evaluation results even under seemingly identical evaluation settings, risking biased conclusions about dLLM decoding methods. To understand this evaluation concern, we conduct a rigorous evaluation of current decoding methods for dLLMs across diverse evaluation settings. Surprisingly, our analysis reveals that the ranking of decoding methods is highly sensitive to the choice of prompt templates. Single-template evaluation can lead to an illusion that decoding methods improve inference efficiency without performance degradation. Through comprehensive experiments, we find that current parallel decoding methods consistently underperform the single-token decoding baseline, failing to overcome the speed-quality trade-off. We further identify this evaluation inconsistency as the high sensitivity of parallel decoding methods to minor variations in prompt templates. Our experiments show that an effective prompt template can achieve strong evaluation results even with fewer denoising steps, markedly outperforming the marginal gain from increasing denoising steps. Beyond prompt templates, our experiments indicate that overlooked evaluation settings can also notably affect the assessment of decoding methods. Based on these findings, we propose practical guidelines for the reliable evaluation of decoding methods in dLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示扩散大语言模型的解码方法评估对提示模板高度敏感，当前并行解码方法实际未能在速度-质量权衡中超越单令牌解码基线，并提出了可靠评估指南。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散大语言模型解码策略的评估结果存在不一致性，即使评估设置看似相同也可能得出有偏结论，需要系统性地厘清这一问题。
AI.method: 在不同评估设置下对当前dLLM解码方法进行严格基准测试，重点分析提示模板等变量对方法排名的影响。
AI.result: 解码方法的排名对提示模板选择高度敏感；当前并行解码方法一致性地逊于单令牌解码基线，未能克服速度-质量权衡；有效的提示模板比增加去噪步数更能提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出了可靠评估dLLM解码方法的实用指南，强调评估设置（如提示模板）的标准化对避免误导性结论至关重要。

title: SemDynReg: Semantics-Guided Deformation Regularization for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an efficient approach for rendering dynamic scenes in a wide range of 3D applications. However, existing deformation field-based approaches largely lack explicit object-level modeling, often resulting in inconsistent Gaussian deformations within individual objects and unwanted coupling between different objects. To address this limitation, we introduce a semantics-guided framework that enforces dynamic regularization at the object level, aiming to achieve spatially consistent object-wise deformation. Specifically, we first extract segmentation masks using the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and derive semantic features from input images. An object-ID map is then constructed via feature relevance matching with a predefined object dictionary. Guided by this object-ID map, we identify the pixel-wise top-k contributing Gaussians for each object and impose consistency regularization on their deformation parameters, including position, scale, and rotation. Unlike prior methods that learn deformation fields without explicit object-level constraints, our approach incorporates semantic cues to guide deformation behavior at the object level. Experimental results demonstrate that our semantics-aware regularization improves object-level deformation consistency and outperforms baseline methods in rendering quality, achieving higher PSNR and SSIM and lower LPIPS in dynamic 3DGS rendering. Our project page is available at https://dyn-reg-3dgs.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语义引导的动态3D高斯泼溅方法，通过引入对象级别的正则化来改进变形一致性，从而提升动态场景渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于变形场的动态3DGS方法缺乏显式的对象级建模，导致对象内部高斯变形不一致以及对象间不必要的耦合。
AI.method: 利用SAM提取分割掩码和语义特征，通过特征匹配构建对象ID图，识别每个对象的top-k贡献高斯，并对这些高斯的变形参数（位置、缩放、旋转）施加一致性正则化。
AI.result: 所提方法在动态3DGS渲染中取得了更高的PSNR和SSIM，更低的LPIPS，优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义感知的正则化能够有效提升对象级别的变形一致性，改善动态场景的渲染质量。

title: The Complexity Ceiling Benchmark: A Multi-Domain Evaluation of Sequential Reasoning Under Depth Scaling
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 1st Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB), CTB@ICML 2026
summary: We introduce the Complexity Ceiling Benchmark (CCB), a controlled evaluation of how language-model reasoning decays as the number of required sequential steps grows. CCB fixes the semantic content of a task and varies only its depth N in {5,...,50} across three structurally distinct regimes: grounded spatial state-tracking, abstract symbolic pointer manipulation, and transitive relational inference. Across 6,000 trials over five frontier and open-weight LLMs we find a consistent pattern of geometric per-step decay with widely separated domain ceilings: on the first two regimes the strongest models retain pd>0.92 across N=50; on the third every model collapses by N=5, with the best model's 50%-success horizon at H0.5~4.7 steps despite pd=0.863. A trace-level metric (TFBC) shows that 14.5% of correct answers across the benchmark are reached via incorrect intermediate reasoning. Forced verbose state-tracking does not move the ceiling (McNemar p=1.000), and the mean step at which reasoning first diverges, k*, predicts within-domain accuracy better than parameter count. CCB and the geometric decay model together reduce a model's long-horizon reasoning profile to one interpretable number per task family.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复杂天花板基准（CCB），通过控制任务语义、仅变化推理深度N（5-50步），在三种结构不同领域中测试大语言模型的推理衰减。发现几何级数的每步衰减模式，且不同领域天花板差异巨大：前两个领域最强模型在N=50时保持pd>0.92，第三个领域所有模型在N=5时崩溃。14.5%的正确回答来自错误中间推理，强制显式状态追踪不改变天花板。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对语言模型推理能力随步骤增长而衰减的系统性、受控评估。作者希望精确量化"推理深度"对模型性能的影响，并揭示不同推理类型之间的能力差异。
AI.method: 设计CCB基准，包含三种推理域：接地空间状态追踪、抽象符号指针操作、传递关系推理。固定任务语义，仅变化推理深度N∈{5,50}。在6000次试验中测试5个前沿及开源LLM，引入几何衰减模型和TFBC（追踪真实但错误推理路径）指标。
AI.result: 前两个域最强模型在N=50时pd>0.92，第三个域所有模型在N=5即崩溃（最佳模型H0.5~4.7步）。14.5%正确答案通过错误中间推理达成。强制显式状态追踪无效（McNemar p=1.000）。首次推理偏离步数k*比参数规模更能预测域内准确率。
AI.conclusion: CCB与几何衰减模型可将模型的长程推理能力简化为每个任务家族的一个可解释数值。不同推理域的天花板高度分离，提示当前LLM在复杂关系推理上存在根本性瓶颈。

title: Travel-Oriented Reasoning Large Language Model via Domain-Specific Knowledge Graphs
comment: Accepted to the Uncertainty Reasoning and Quantification in Decision Making (UDM) Workshop, KDD 2026 (To be presented in August 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate broad reasoning abilities but struggle with accuracy and reliability in specialized domains such as travel, where reasoning depends on precise definitions, rules, and expert-defined conceptual frameworks, and where confident but unfounded outputs arise from a reasoning failure in which the model has not internalized the underlying domain graph rather than from missing domain knowledge alone. We propose a modular pipeline for building a travel-domain reasoning LLM grounded in an expert-designed knowledge graph (KG). Our pipeline integrates a travel KG that encodes domain entities and their relationships, a bottom-up construction procedure that walks the KG to produce multi-hop question answer (QA) pairs, a supervised fine-tuning stage that embeds the domain knowledge into a reasoning-capable LLM using the generated QA pairs as auditable reasoning traces, and a travel-domain benchmark dataset that measures the fine-tuned model's accuracy and calibration. We evaluate our approach using Qwen3-4B with LoRA adaptation. Our reasoning model achieves an $82.4\%$ exact match on the benchmark. This performance significantly outperforms the pretrained Qwen3-4B baseline at $22.4\%$. A calibration analysis decomposes the residual $17.57\%$ of errors into two distinct failure modes: an over-confident multi-label decoder that predicts both correct answers plus one spurious option on most dual-answer mistakes, and a smaller reasoning failure on single-answer questions where the supporting facts are present in the KG but the model fails to reconstruct the correct multi-hop path. This split confirms that explicit KG-grounded reasoning substantially improves the accuracy and uncertainty interpretation of LLMs in specialized domains, and isolates per-option calibration and trace-length-aware decoding as the next axes of improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于专家设计知识图谱的模块化流水线，用于构建旅游领域推理大语言模型，通过KG增强的QA生成和微调，将基线准确率从22.4%提升至82.4%，并分解了剩余错误的两种模式。
AI.motivation: LLM在旅游等专业领域推理时，由于未内化底层领域图结构，会出现自信但无根据的输出。这种失败不仅源于缺少领域知识，更源于没有掌握领域概念间的推理关系。
AI.method: 构建旅游知识图谱（KG）→自底向上遍历KG生成多跳QA对→使用QA对作为可审计推理轨迹进行有监督微调→构建旅游领域基准数据集评估。采用Qwen3-4B+LoRA实现。
AI.result: 微调模型在基准上达到82.4%精确匹配，远超基线22.4%。剩余17.57%错误分为：过度自信的多标签解码器（多数双答案错误）和单答案问题上的推理失败。
AI.conclusion: 显式KG接地推理显著提升了专业领域LLM的准确性和不确定性解释能力，并指明了逐选项校准和路径长度感知解码是下一步改进方向。

title: BackTranslation2.0 -- A Linguistically Motivated Metric to Assess Sign Language Production
summary: Sign Languages (SLs) are the primary means of communication for millions of deaf individuals, yet existing evaluation metrics for generated SL remain simplistic and poorly aligned with human judgements. We introduce BackTranslation2.0, a linguistically grounded evaluation metric for text-to-sign translation that moves beyond naïve backtranslation. Our approach adopts an agentic framework in which a deterministic pipeline orchestrates a suite of specialised tools to assess four scoring dimensions - grammatical correctness, phonological accuracy, motion fluency, and generation fidelity - aligned with human rater assessments. Tool outputs are not treated independently: a set of large language model (LLM)-based cross-referential comparison modules evaluates consistency across tools and checks outputs against linguistic expectations, enabling structured reasoning over grammatical, phonological, and motion-level evidence. Final dimension scores are computed through deterministic weighted formulas over validated tool outputs. To validate BackTranslation2.0, we introduce and evaluate on a British Sign Language (BSL) dataset rated in a human rater study across the same quality dimensions, following a protocol developed in collaboration between linguists and deaf experts, benchmarking against six baseline metrics. Our method demonstrates strong correlation with human judgements across all dimensions, providing a more comprehensive, interpretable, and linguistically principled evaluation framework for sign language production systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BackTranslation2.0，一种基于语言学的手语生成评估指标，通过智能体框架整合多工具评分维度，并与人工评估高度相关。
AI.motivation: 现有手语评估指标过于简单且与人工判断不一致，缺乏语言学基础的评估标准。
AI.method: 采用确定性流水线驱动的智能体框架，整合语法正确性、音韵准确性、动作流畅性和生成保真度四个评分维度，并通过LLM交叉引用模块进行一致性验证，最终通过加权公式计算分数。
AI.result: 在英式手语数据集上与六种基线指标对比，BackTranslation2.0在所有维度上与人工判断呈现强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了更全面、可解释、且具有语言学原则的手语生成系统评估框架。

title: Process Advantage Signal Shaping: A Paradigm-Agnostic Middleware for Process-Supervised RL in LLM Reasoners
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a default recipe for process-supervised reinforcement learning of LLM reasoners, and dense process supervision -- via learned process reward models (PRMs) or on-policy-distillation KL signals -- is a common way to densify its otherwise weak outcome reward. Layering such a step-level signal on top of GRPO's group-standardized advantage, however, exposes three structural pathologies: \emph{channel contamination} between the pooled process, outcome, and format streams at group standardization; \emph{resolution mismatch} between the granularity of the process signal and the granularity of the logical decisions being credited; and a \emph{cumulative trap} by which GRPO's return-to-go sum surfaces either length inflation or truncated exploration depending on the sign regime of the signal. We propose \textbf{PASS} (\emph{Process Advantage Signal Shaping}), a compact middleware that sits between any scalar step-level process signal and GRPO's clipped surrogate and addresses the three pathologies in turn: \emph{Advantage Fusion} standardizes the three streams independently within each group, \emph{Chunk-by-Value} derives value-homogeneous chunks from the signal itself and broadcasts credit within each chunk, and \emph{Divide-Length} converts the cumulative objective into an average-value-density score. We validate PASS across two domains and two process-signal paradigms -- a learned PRM on mathematical reasoning and an on-policy-distillation KL signal (with a generalized variant) on multi-hop question answering -- and under two group-standardization operators. In every regime PASS delivers a consistent pass@1 gain over the corresponding GRPO baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PASS方法，针对GRPO在过程监督强化学习中存在的三种结构性问题（通道污染、分辨率不匹配、累积陷阱），通过三项改进（优势融合、按值分块、长度归一化）显著提升LLM推理器的性能。
AI.motivation: GRPO在过程监督强化学习中存在三个结构性问题：1) 通道污染（channel contamination）——组标准化时混合了过程、结果和格式信号；2) 分辨率不匹配（resolution mismatch）——过程信号粒度与逻辑决策粒度不一致；3) 累积陷阱（cumulative trap）——返回和导致长度膨胀或截断探索。
AI.method: 提出PASS（Process Advantage Signal Shaping）方法，包含三个组件：1) Advantage Fusion——在组内独立标准化三个信号流；2) Chunk-by-Value——将信号划分为值同质块并在块内分配信用；3) Divide-Length——将累积目标转换为平均价值密度分数。
AI.result: 在数学推理（使用PRM）和多跳问答（使用策略蒸馏KL信号）两个领域，以及两种组标准化操作符下，PASS在所有设置中均一致地比对应GRPO基线取得pass@1收益提升。
AI.conclusion: PASS作为一种轻量级中间件，有效解决了GRPO在过程监督强化学习中的结构性问题，显著提升了LLM推理器的性能，且具有较好的通用性和可迁移性。

title: MIThinker: A Plug-and-Play Policy-Optimized Thinker For Motivational Interviewing Counseling
summary: Reasoning large language models (LLMs) have recently made much progress in complex problem-solving, leveraging internal reasoning (or thought) to guide their solution generation. However, existing LLM-based counseling agents, including those using Motivational Interviewing (MI), generate responses without explicitly aligning thoughts with counseling techniques, limiting their effectiveness. We propose MIThinker, a lightweight thinking model that generates therapeutic thoughts to guide MI counseling agents in strategy selection and response generation. To overcome the lack of annotated thought data, we introduce AugR1-MI, an automated pipeline that reverse-engineers counselor's thoughts from observed responses. Through two-stage training combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, MIThinker demonstrates improved theory-of-mind assessment and strategy alignment. Comprehensive evaluations show that MindfulMI, our agent leveraging MIThinker, achieves MI competency comparable to state-of-the-art systems with an order of magnitude less computation.

AI.tldr: 提出MIThinker轻量级思维模型，通过AugR1-MI自动管道逆向工程生成治疗性思维，结合监督微调和强化学习训练，使MI咨询代理在策略选择和响应生成上达到与最先进系统相当的MI能力，但计算量减少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的咨询代理（包括使用动机性访谈的）在生成响应时没有明确地将思维与咨询技术对齐，限制了其有效性。
AI.method: 提出MIThinker轻量级思维模型，通过AugR1-MI自动管道逆向工程从观察到的响应中提取咨询师的思维，采用两阶段训练（监督微调+强化学习）。
AI.result: MindfulMI代理利用MIThinker，在MI能力上与最先进系统相当，但计算量减少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: MIThinker能有效提升MI咨询代理的策略对齐和响应生成效果，且计算效率显著优于现有方法。

title: Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to take actions in the real world and support human decision-making, yet most agents rely on parametric knowledge, fixed post-training data, retrieval, or search. This paradigm breaks down in novel domains and for sophisticated queries that cannot be answered from prior knowledge alone. Knowing the laws of physics, for instance, does not by itself enable LLMs to answer queries or complete long-horizon tasks in a complex physical system. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA), an in-context self-improvement framework to learn from active experimentation. HExA iteratively designs and refines query-relevant experiments, learns a reusable library of composable skills from experience, and integrates experimental evidence to answer queries or take actions. HExA is training-free, compatible with any black-box model, and does not require external supervision, oracles, or offline data. To evaluate active experimentation, we introduce Interphyre, a tool-calling benchmark built on the PHYRE 2D procedural physics environment, where agents propose interventions and test hypotheses through simulation APIs. Experiments show that current LLM agents struggle in these settings, especially on the hardest levels of Interphyre. Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieves only 2% success, while HExA improves the same model to up to 77% success. HExA also improves open-weight models and outperforms agentic baselines such as ReAct and Reflexion. Moreover, using only skills learned from easier levels and transferred without active experimentation, HExA achieves 44% success, demonstrating the reusability and generalization of its learned skills. Overall, HExA shows that learning through active experimentation can help agents discover useful knowledge, acquire reusable skills, and make efficient progress on novel long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HExA框架，通过主动实验学习让LLM智能体在复杂物理环境中自我提升，无需训练或外部监督，在Interphyre基准测试中将Claude Sonnet 4.6的成功率从2%提升至77%。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM智能体依赖参数化知识或检索，无法处理无法从先验知识回答的新颖领域和复杂查询问题，例如理解复杂物理系统中的长时任务。
AI.method: 提出HExA（分层实验智能体框架），通过上下文学习实现自我改进：迭代设计并优化与查询相关的实验，从经验中学习可复用的技能库，综合实验证据回答问题或采取行动。无需训练、外部监督或离线数据。
AI.result: 在Interphyre基准上，Claude Sonnet 4.6仅2%成功率，HExA提升至77%；HExA还改进了开源模型，优于ReAct和Reflexion等基线；仅从简单关卡迁移技能，HExA达到44%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动实验学习，智能体能够发现有用知识、获取可复用技能，并在新颖的长时任务中取得高效进展。

title: A Hybrid Framework for Song Lyric Annotation Based on Human-LLM Alignment
summary: Emotion recognition of song lyrics is a challenging task since lyrics may not necessarily align with the overall emotion of a song. As a result, lyrics annotation remains largely underexplored. Drawing inspiration from research in large language model (LLM) assisted annotation, we examine the alignment between humans and LLMs for annotation of lyrics by creating a new sentence-level dataset of lyrics. Our observations highlight the subjectivity of the task and the inherent challenges. Following this, we present a hybrid annotation framework that optimizes human and LLM annotation by predicting potential misalignment in annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了歌词情感识别中人类与LLM标注的对齐问题，提出了一个混合标注框架来优化两者协作。
AI.motivation: 歌词情感识别具有挑战性，因为歌词与歌曲整体情感可能不一致，导致歌词标注领域研究不足。
AI.method: 创建了句子级歌词数据集，观察人类与LLM标注的对齐情况，提出混合标注框架预测潜在的不对齐情况以优化标注过程。
AI.result: 发现歌词标注存在主观性挑战，人类与LLM标注之间存在不一致。
AI.conclusion: 混合标注框架通过预测对齐问题来优化人类与LLM在歌词标注中的协作。

title: SATB-VR: Training Few-Step Video Restoration Diffusion Model using SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending
summary: While diffusion models excel in video restoration, their reliance on extensive iterative steps limits efficiency. Conversely, aggressive single-step distillation often compromises fine texture recovery. To achieve an optimal balance, we present SATB-VR, a few-step paradigm that jump-starts the denoising process via an auxiliary predictor, explicitly bypassing early low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) steps. However, naive joint training of the predictor and the denoiser inherently introduces a severe train-inference discrepancy. To resolve this, we propose the SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending (SATB) strategy. During the forward process, SATB constructs the noisy input by dynamically blending the predictor's output with the ground-truth trajectory based on the SNRs. This forces the denoiser to robustly compensate for initial prediction errors while smoothly converging to the clean data manifold. Furthermore, we introduce a Denoiser-Driven Consistency (DDC) loss, leveraging the concurrently updated denoiser as a dynamic evaluator to explicitly align internal features and boost predictor accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, under flexible few-step inference regimes (\eg, $\le 5$ steps), SATB-VR performs favorably against existing approaches on synthetic, real-world, and AIGC benchmarks.

AI.tldr: SATB-VR提出了一种基于SNR感知轨迹混合策略的少步视频恢复范式，通过辅助预测器跳过早期低信噪比步骤，结合去噪器驱动的 consistency 损失，在≤5步推理下达到甚至超越现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在视频恢复中效果优异但迭代步骤过多导致效率低下，而激进单步蒸馏又会牺牲细粒度纹理恢复质量，因此需要在效率与质量之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.method: 1) 使用辅助预测器跳过早期低信噪比步骤，实现少步去噪；2) 提出SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending (SATB)策略，在正向过程中根据SNR动态混合预测器输出与真实轨迹，缓解训练-推理不一致性；3) 引入Denoiser-Driven Consistency (DDC)损失，利用去噪器作为动态评估器对齐内部特征并提升预测器精度。
AI.result: 在合成、真实世界和AIGC基准上，SATB-VR在≤5步的灵活少步推理设置下优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SATB-VR通过SNR感知轨迹混合与去噪器驱动的 consistency 约束，成功实现了少步视频恢复中效率与质量的平衡，验证了跳过低信噪比步骤的有效性。

title: PHF: Privileged Hidden Flow for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a reasoning model on rollouts sampled from its own policy by matching a privileged teacher that also sees verified reference solutions. Existing OPSD objectives supervise only the output distribution, so privileged context affects training through a token-level divergence without directly supervising the internal computation that produced that distribution. We propose Privileged Hidden Flow (PHF), which additionally distills how a privileged teacher's hidden states move along the same rollout. Rather than forcing each student hidden vector to match the teacher vector at the same token position, PHF aligns token-to-token transition directions and trajectory geometry over selected generated positions. The all-layer recipe also includes an adjacent-layer relation computed from these same transitions, without pointwise hidden-state imitation. Under the same 100-step training schedule, PHF improves the Average@12 aggregate over our reproduced OPSD baseline on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, with observed gains of about +2.2, +1.5, and +1.7 points. The transport objective is exactly invariant to shared trajectory offsets; its local geometry term is also invariant to orthogonal transformations of transition directions. Ablations distinguish the fixed PHF recipe from pointwise hidden-state matching, single-channel transition losses, and layer-subset choices, supporting PHF as a compact hidden-flow extension to OPSD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Privileged Hidden Flow (PHF)，通过额外蒸馏教师模型的隐藏状态流动（而非仅输出分布）来改进同策略自蒸馏方法，在多个Qwen3模型上取得约+1.5到+2.2点的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）目标仅监督输出分布，缺乏对产生该分布的内部计算过程的直接监督，导致特权上下文信息未能充分利用。
AI.method: PHF对齐学生与教师模型的token间转移方向和轨迹几何结构，而非逐点隐藏状态匹配；包含所有层的相邻层关系计算，且对共享轨迹偏移具有精确不变性，局部几何项对正交变换不变。
AI.result: 在100步训练计划下，Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B上分别提升约+2.2、+1.5和+1.7个Average@12点。
AI.conclusion: PHF作为OPSD的紧凑隐藏流扩展，通过消融实验验证了其各部分设计的有效性，优于逐点匹配和单通道过渡损失等替代方案。

title: LogiCo: A Unified Framework for Logical and Structural Anomaly Detection
summary: Current anomaly detection methods primarily focus on structural anomalies, while paying insufficient attention to anomalies that violate logical constraints. Conversely, top-performing logical anomaly detection approaches address this by modeling global semantic consistency, but perform poorly on subtle structural anomalies due to inadequate detection granularity. In this paper, we propose LogiCo, a unified framework for Logical and structural anomaly detection via Component-level feature reconstruction. Unlike existing methods that rely on explicit global semantic modeling, LogiCo employs a novel component-level feature reconstruction technique to capture inter-component logical constraints. Specifically, LogiCo maps pre-trained image features into a discrete component-level feature space and performs collaborative feature reconstruction at both component and patch levels, enabling it to effectively detect both logical and structural anomalies. Furthermore, to address the specific challenge of count-related logical anomalies, we integrate a segmentation-map discriminator that extends the model's capability to identify quantitative inconsistencies. LogiCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both logical and structural anomaly detection across four benchmarks, including MVTec-LOCO, MVTec-AD, VisA, and Real-IAD, demonstrating its superiority and practical feasibility. The code is available at https://github.com/cnulab/LogiCo.

AI.tldr: 提出LogiCo统一框架，通过组件级特征重建同时检测逻辑异常和结构异常，在四个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对逻辑约束违反的关注不足，而顶级逻辑异常检测方法对细微结构异常检测效果差。
AI.method: 将预训练图像特征映射到离散组件级特征空间，在组件和补丁级别进行协同特征重建，并集成分割图判别器处理计数相关逻辑异常。
AI.result: 在MVTec-LOCO、MVTec-AD、VisA和Real-IAD四个基准上，逻辑和结构异常检测均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: LogiCo框架有效统一了逻辑异常与结构异常检测，具备优越性和实际可行性。

title: When LLMs Develop Languages: Symbolic Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves large language models (LLMs) on difficult reasoning tasks, but it often incurs long natural-language rationales that are poorly aligned with efficient machine reasoning. We propose Communicative Language Symbolism Routing (CLSR), a test-time framework in which multiple LLM agents autonomously invent, evolve, and share compact Language Symbolism Frameworks (LSFs), while a latent-free router adaptively selects and composes these languages per query to optimize the accuracy-token trade-off. Unlike prompt optimization that refines surface instructions, CLSR treats each LSF as a reusable symbolic protocol with compact symbols, usage rules, and a message-passing contract, and improves it through an evolutionary loop driven by correctness and token cost. At inference time, the router may invoke a single low-cost LSF call, ensemble multiple LSFs, or execute a multi-round LSF composition protocol on harder queries. Across challenging benchmarks, CLSR reduces latency-oriented generated token completion by $3\sim 6\times$ compared to standard CoT while maintaining accuracy. We further derive an information-theoretic lower bound on token cost under arbitrary symbolism and show that, under an interpreter-realizability premise, multi-round LSF protocols conditionally subsume program-execution pipelines. Code is publicly available (https://github.com/pzqpzq/LSF_MDia).

AI.tldr: CLSR是一种测试时框架，通过多个LLM智能体自主创建和进化紧凑的符号语言框架（LSF），并利用路由器自适应选择最优语言组合，在保持精度的同时将生成token数减少3-6倍。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-Thought虽然能提升LLM在复杂推理任务上的表现，但其生成的长篇自然语言推理链与高效机器推理之间存在严重不匹配，导致token开销过大。
AI.method: 提出CLSR框架，包含：(1) 多个LLM智能体自主发明、进化和共享紧凑的Language Symbolism Frameworks (LSFs)；(2) 一个无潜在变量的路由器自适应选择并组合这些符号语言；(3) 通过基于正确性和token成本的进化循环持续优化LSF。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性基准上，与标准CoT相比，CLSR将面向延迟的生成token数减少3-6倍，同时保持准确率。
AI.conclusion: CLSR通过符号化语言协议有效权衡了推理准确性与token开销，并推导了任意符号主义下token成本的信息论下界，证明了多轮LSF协议在解释器可实现前提下可条件性地涵盖程序执行管道。

title: Cross-Temporal Sinhala OCR: Page-Level Adaptation and Diachronic Analysis
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 12th Moratuwa Engineering Research Conference (MERCon) 2026
summary: Sinhala is a morphologically rich abugida spoken by roughly 16 million people in Sri Lanka, and to date, there are no publicly available real-world datasets for page-level Sinhala OCR. All previous studies for assessing Sinhala OCR models have used artificially generated data. To bridge the gap, we introduce sinhala-ocr-lk-acts-1010, an annotated dataset of 1,010 page-level images and their transcriptions collected from Sri Lankan Legislative Acts published between 1981-1989 and 2000-2019, split into 707 training examples, 101 validation examples, and 202 testing examples. Three models based on deep learning-based visual language processing, namely DeepSeek-OCR V1, DeepSeek-OCR V2, and LightOnOCR-2-1B, are fine-tuned using QLoRA in 8 experiments conducted on consumer and cloud GPUs. LightOnOCR-2-1B is the top performer, achieving a CER of 1.05% across all test examples, outperforming state-of-the-art open-source OCR models such as Surya-OCR (8.84%) and Tesseract v5 (10.69%), as well as commercially available OCR models such as Google Document AI (2.06%). Our results suggest that LightOnOCR-2-1B outperforms other baselines on real-world OCR tasks and maintains consistent performance across all print periods, even when documents are severely degraded.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个真实世界僧伽罗语页面级OCR数据集 sinhala-ocr-lk-acts-1010，并基于LightOnOCR-2-1B模型微调，达到1.05%的字符错误率，显著优于现有开源和商业OCR模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的僧伽罗语OCR研究均使用人工生成数据，缺乏真实世界的公开数据集，导致模型在真实场景下的性能评估存在空白。
AI.method: 收集1010页斯里兰卡立法法案图像并标注，使用QLoRA对DeepSeek-OCR V1、DeepSeek-OCR V2、LightOnOCR-2-1B三个深度学习模型进行微调，在消费级和云端GPU上完成8组实验。
AI.result: LightOnOCR-2-1B以1.05%的字符错误率（CER）领先，显著优于Surya-OCR（8.84%）、Tesseract v5（10.69%）和Google Document AI（2.06%）。
AI.conclusion: LightOnOCR-2-1B在真实僧伽罗语OCR任务中表现最优，且在各类印刷年代和严重退化的文档上均保持稳定性能。

title: Diagnosing and Repairing Factual Errors in RAG under Budget Constraints
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in external evidence, yet real-world deployments remain fragile. Failures often stem from missing or weakly relevant evidence, as well as from generation that does not faithfully reflect the retrieved context. Many existing approaches rely on fine-tuning, privileged access to internal model signals, or resource-insensitive escalation strategies, which limits their practicality in black-box and budget-constrained settings. We propose D2R-RAG (Diagnose-to-Repair RAG), a model-agnostic and resource-aware framework that combines lightweight failure diagnosis with adaptive repair. D2R-RAG derives interpretable failure signatures from observable signals in the query, retrieved evidence, and generated response, and then selects from a small set of corrective actions under explicit latency and VRAM constraints. Experiments on FEVER and HotpotQA show that D2R-RAG improves reliability over recent baselines and achieves better accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across multiple compute budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/CyberScienceLab/D2R-RAG/.

AI.tldr: D2R-RAG是一种模型无关且资源感知的框架，通过轻量级故障诊断和自适应修复，在有限计算预算下提升RAG系统的可靠性和准确性-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统存在检索证据缺失/弱相关、生成不忠实反映上下文等故障，而现有方法依赖微调、内部模型信号或资源不敏感的升级策略，在黑盒和预算受限场景下实用性受限。
AI.method: 提出Diagnose-to-Repair (D2R-RAG)框架：从查询、检索证据和生成响应的可观测信号中提取可解释的故障签名，然后在显式延迟和VRAM约束下选择少量纠错动作进行自适应修复。
AI.result: 在FEVER和HotpotQA数据集上，D2R-RAG相比近期基线方法提升了可靠性，并在多种计算预算下实现了更好的准确性-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: D2R-RAG通过轻量级诊断与资源感知修复的结合，为黑盒、预算受限的RAG部署提供了一种实用的可靠性提升方案。

title: LC-ICL: Label-Guided Contrastive In-Context Learning for Robust Information Extraction
summary: There has been increasing interest in exploring the capabilities of advanced large language models (LLMs) in the field of information extraction (IE), specifically focusing on tasks related to named entity recognition (NER) and relation extraction (RE).Although researchers are exploring the use of few-shot information extraction through in-context learning with LLMs, they tend to focus only on using correct or positive examples for demonstration, neglecting the potential value of incorporating incorrect or negative examples into the learning process.In this paper, we present LC-ICL a novel few-shot technique that leverages both correct and incorrect sample constructions to create in-context learning demonstrations. This approach enhances the ability of LLMs to extract entities and relations by combining positive samples with negative samples annotated by error-cause labels. These labels expose more detailed error features in erroneous examples, enabling the model to understand why similar predictions fail and avoid repeating such errors during inference.Specifically, our proposed method taps into the inherent contextual information and valuable information in hard negative samples and the nearest positive neighbors to the test and then applies the in-context learning demonstrations based on LLMs. Our experiments on various datasets indicate that LC-ICL outperforms previous few-shot in-context learning methods, delivering substantial enhancements in performance across a broad spectrum of related tasks. These improvements are noteworthy, showcasing the versatility of our approach in diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LC-ICL方法，通过结合正确样本和带有错误原因标签的错误样本来构建上下文学习示例，显著提升了LLM在命名实体识别和关系抽取任务上的少样本信息提取性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM少样本信息提取研究只使用正确示例进行上下文学习，忽视了错误样本（负面样本）的潜在价值。
AI.method: LC-ICL方法利用正确样本和带有错误原因标签的错误样本共同构建上下文学习演示，从硬负样本和测试样本的最近正邻居中挖掘信息，帮助模型理解预测失败的原因并避免重复错误。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，LC-ICL优于以往的少样本上下文学习方法，在NER和RE相关任务上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 引入带有错误原因标签的负面样本进行上下文学习，能有效提升LLM在信息提取任务中的表现，该方法具有良好的通用性和适应性。

title: CCRC: A Change-Aware Captioning and Reasoning Chain for Image Change Captioning and Segmentation
summary: Understanding and localizing subtle changes between paired images is critical for tasks such as surveillance and image editing. However, traditional Image Change Captioning (ICC) methods lack spatial grounding, limiting their precision. We introduce Image Change Captioning and Segmentation (ICCS), a new multimodal task that jointly requires structured change description and pixel-level localization. To address ICCS, we propose the Change-aware Captioning and Reasoning Chain (CCRC), a dual-chain framework that decouples semantic reasoning from spatial segmentation. The first chain, Chain-of-Change-Captioning (CCC), enhances fine-grained change perception via a visual fusion module based on Multi-Head Change-aware Attention inserted between the visual and language components of a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). CCC also determines whether a change is segmentable. If not, it alone generates the caption. Otherwise, the second chain, Chain-of-Change-Segmenting (CCS), is activated, leveraging spatial priors from CCC and refining masks with a Change-aware Token Refiner for accurate boundary localization. We evaluate CCRC on both synthetic and real-world change detection benchmarks with pixel-level supervision. Experiments show CCRC achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICCS新任务（联合图像变化描述与分割），并设计CCRC双链框架（CCC语义链+CCS分割链），通过多头变化感知注意力模块和变化感知标记精炼器，在合成与真实数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统图像变化描述（ICC）方法缺乏空间定位能力，无法精确指出变化发生的位置，因此需要一种既能描述变化又能进行像素级定位的新方法。
AI.method: 提出CCRC双链框架：1）CCC链通过多头变化感知注意力融合模块增强细粒度变化感知，并判断变化是否可分割；2）若可分割则激活CCS链，利用CCC的空间先验并通过变化感知标记精炼器细化分割掩码。
AI.result: 在合成和真实变化检测基准上，CCRC方法达到了当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 将变化描述与分割联合建模能够有效提升变化理解的精确性，双链解耦策略优于传统单一任务方法。

title: LLM-Guided Planning for Multi-hop Reasoning over Multimodal Nuclear Regulatory Documents
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond @ ICML 2026. 8 pages (main), 3 figures, 1 algorithm
summary: Reviewing nuclear regulatory documents requires multi-hop reasoning across tens of thousands of pages, where judgments depend on evidence assembled across multiple chapters. We frame this task as planning: an LLM-based agent observes the evidence collected so far, picks the next document fragment to inspect, and stops when the evidence is sufficient. The agent operates over a vectorless document tree using browse, read, and search tools, and maintains a dynamic knowledge graph (KG) as state. On a 200-question benchmark over NuScale Final Safety Analysis Report (FSAR) documents, the system reaches 81.5% accuracy with a RAGAS Faithfulness of 0.93. The dominant performance factor is planning: against PageIndex, which uses the same document tree without state-conditioned action selection, the gap is +38.0pp (43.5% to 81.5%, p<0.001). The system also outperforms LightRAG (73.0%, p<0.05), HippoRAG (70.5%, p<0.01), and GraphRAG (49.5%, p<0.001), and matches RAPTOR (75.5%, p=0.11) without offline indexing. Edge inference adds 2.8x cost without raising accuracy; we retain it as a traceability module. Of 7,391 inferred edges, 3 Violates edges (0.04%) flag scope boundaries (Q058) and partial conformance (Q176) as typed annotations that a human reviewer can audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于LLM agent的规划方法，用于核监管文档的多跳推理审查。系统在无向量文档树上通过浏览、阅读、搜索工具及动态知识图谱进行证据收集与规划决策，在200题基准上达到81.5%准确率（RAGAS忠诚度0.93），显著优于多种检索增强生成基线方法。规划能力是性能主导因素，相较无状态动作选择的PageIndex提升38个百分点。
AI.motivation: 核监管文档审查需在数万页文档中进行多跳推理，传统方法难以高效、准确地收集和整合跨章节证据，需要一种能主动规划证据收集路径的智能系统。
AI.method: 将审查任务建模为规划问题：LLM agent基于已收集证据动态选择下一个文档片段，使用浏览、阅读、搜索工具在无向量文档树上操作，并维护动态知识图谱作为状态。知识图谱也可作为可审计的推理轨迹模块。
AI.result: 在NuScale最终安全分析报告的200题基准上达到81.5%准确率（忠诚度0.93）。相比PageIndex（无状态动作选择）提升38个百分点（p<0.001），优于LightRAG（73.0%）、HippoRAG（70.5%）、GraphRAG（49.5%）及RAPTOR（75.5%，p=0.11）。7391条推断边中只有3条（0.04%）为违反边可被审计。
AI.conclusion: 基于规划的方法在核监管文档审查中显著优于传统RAG方法，状态条件动作选择是性能关键。动态知识图谱既能提升准确率，又能提供可审计的推理轨迹，在保证高性能的同时实现了可解释性。

title: EntroRouter: Learning Efficient Model Routing via Entropy Regulation
summary: Model routing balances solution accuracy and computational cost by selecting among models of varying capabilities. While recent multi-round frameworks interleave reasoning and planning, we identify a structural failure mode termed Trust Region Collapse. We demonstrate that the deep coupling of reasoning and routing, exacerbated by the dominance of strong pre-training priors under sparse supervision, leads to degenerate local optima where capable experts are systematically suppressed. To decouple these processes, we propose $\textbf{EntroRouter}$, a single-round routing framework that treats entropy regulation as a core objective. We first initialize the policy via Soft Supervision, fitting a distribution of suitable models to establish a high-entropy prior for exploration. Subsequently, we stabilize Reinforcement Learning using a Soft Anchor, which utilizes offline capability estimates to orchestrate controlled entropy contraction within a safe trust region. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EntroRouter retains 98.3% of the strongest expert's accuracy while reducing computational costs by 48.25%.

AI.tldr: 提出EntroRouter框架，通过熵正则化解耦推理与路由，在保留98.3%最优专家精度的同时降低48.25%计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮路由框架中推理与路由深度耦合，在稀疏监督下强预训练先验导致"信任区域坍缩"，使能力强的专家被系统性抑制。
AI.method: 1) 软监督初始化：拟合合适模型分布建立高熵先验；2) 软锚定强化学习：利用离线能力估计控制熵在安全信任区域内收缩。
AI.result: 保留98.3%最强专家精度，降低48.25%计算成本。
AI.conclusion: EntroRouter通过解耦推理与路由过程，有效克服信任区域坍缩问题，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算开销。

title: FreqOrtho-SR: Frequency-Guided Orthogonal Expert Learning for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion prior-based methods have shown impressive results in real-world image super-resolution (ISR), yet two key challenges persist: balancing pixel-level fidelity with semantic quality, and adapting to diverse degradations. Existing dual-branch approaches freeze the pixel module during semantic training, but the semantic branch can still expand capacity within the pixel subspace, precluding genuine perceptual improvement. Moreover, using a single static adapter cannot generalize across heterogeneous real-world corruptions. To address both issues, we propose FreqOrtho-SR, which comprises: $\textbf{Freq}$uency-guided Mixture of LoRA Experts (FreqMoE), it routes inputs to specialized experts via a non-parametric FFT-based degradation-feature extractor that encodes frequency-domain signatures, enabling stable and interpretable specialization across corruption types; and $\textbf{Ortho}$gonal Gradient Projection (OGP), which reframes the dual-objective optimization as a subspace-constrained problem: by extracting the pixel-fidelity subspace via SVD on combined expert weight deltas and projecting semantic gradients onto its null space, OGP guarantees orthogonality between the two objectives, enabling genuinely complementary learning without mutual interference. Experiments show that FreqOrtho-SR achieves competitive overall performance and a strong fidelity-perception trade-off across multiple benchmarks with efficient single-step inference. The source code of our method can be found at $\href{https://github.com/sonhm3029/FreqOrtho-SR}{\texttt{sonhm3029/FreqOrtho-SR}}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FreqOrtho-SR方法，通过频率引导的混合LoRA专家（FreqMoE）和正交梯度投影（OGP）机制，解决了扩散先验图像超分辨率中保真度与语义质量平衡、以及适配多样退化两大挑战，在多个基准上取得了竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散先验超分辨率方法存在两个关键问题：1）双分支方法在训练语义分支时冻结像素模块，语义分支仍会在像素子空间内扩展容量，无法实现真正的感知质量提升；2）使用单一静态适配器难以泛化到异构的真实世界退化类型。
AI.method: 提出FreqOrtho-SR方法，包含两个核心组件：1）FreqMoE（频率引导的混合LoRA专家），通过非参数化FFT退化特征提取器编码频域签名，将输入路由到对应的专门化专家；2）OGP（正交梯度投影），将双目标优化重构为子空间约束问题，通过对专家权重增量进行SVD提取像素保真度子空间，将语义梯度投影到其零空间，确保两个目标正交且互不干扰。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，FreqOrtho-SR取得了具有竞争力的整体性能，并在保真度与感知质量之间实现了良好的权衡，且支持高效的单步推理。
AI.conclusion: FreqOrtho-SR通过频率引导的专家路由和正交梯度投影，有效解决了扩散超分辨率中保真度与语义质量的冲突以及对多样退化的适配问题，实现了真正互补的双目标学习。

title: Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Existing multi-agent debate frameworks suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on static architectures where agent roles and coordination patterns are fixed at design time, and they require instantiating multiple model copies, incurring substantial computational overhead. We propose Mixture of Debaters (MoD), a unified framework that enables dynamic self-debate within a single model by leveraging the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm. We address three key challenges in adapting MoE for dialectical reasoning: (1) dual-routing that decouples role allocation from process flow, dynamically determining when to debate versus when to synthesize; (2) momentum switching that smooths token-level routing with local context, reducing expert-switch jitter; and (3) unified self-debate that encapsulates diverse debating personas into lightweight expert modules, eliminating inter-agent communication while preserving behavioral diversity. Extensive experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MoD outperforms both single-model baselines and conventional multi-agent systems, achieving superior accuracy with 3.7x lower latency and 87% reduction in token consumption.The source code can be accessed at https://github.com/YongLD/MoD.

AI.tldr: 提出MoD框架，通过MoE范式在单模型内实现动态自我辩论，相比传统多智能体系统，准确率更高、延迟降低3.7倍、Token消耗减少87%。
AI.motivation: 现有辩论框架存在静态架构和多模型副本带来的高计算开销两大局限。
AI.method: 提出三方面改进：(1)双路由机制解耦角色分配与流程；(2)动量切换平滑token级路由；(3)统一自我辩论将多种辩论角色封装为轻量级专家模块。
AI.result: 在多模态基准上超越单模型基线和传统多智能体系统，延迟降低3.7倍，Token消耗减少87%。
AI.conclusion: MoD框架有效解决了多智能体辩论的高计算成本问题，实现了高效、动态的自我辩论推理。

title: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Agent Dynamics in World Models
summary: Generative world models hold immense promise as scalable simulators for autonomous systems, particularly for synthesizing rare but safety-critical multi-agent interactions, such as vehicle collisions. However, current evaluation paradigms index heavily on visual fidelity and semantic alignment, leaving a critical blind spot: they cannot reliably quantify whether generated dynamics actually obey the fundamental physical laws required for reliable simulation. Assessing this physical plausibility is inherently difficult due to a lack of physical metrics and the challenge of extracting metric-scale kinematics from uncalibrated video rollouts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CrashTwin, a physics-grounded evaluation framework designed to stress-test the physical trustworthiness of world models. CrashTwin couples a diverse dataset of multi-agent collision scenarios, comprising 25K controllable synthetic and 12K in-the-wild real-world collision sequences with a novel calibration-free reconstruction pipeline, enabling the recovery of 3D physical attributes directly from world model rollouts. We propose a diagnostic suite that systematically evaluates three dimensions: spatio-temporal consistency, momentum and kinetic energy conservation, and world-dynamics integrity. Extensive benchmarking of state-of-the-art models reveals a crucial insight: high perceptual quality frequently masks severe physical violations during complex interactions. By quantitatively exposing these failure modes, CrashTwin provides a vital diagnostic tool for developing physically grounded world models capable of reliable real-world simulation.

AI.tldr: CrashTwin 是一个物理约束下的评估框架，用于检测世界模型在生成多智能体交互（如车辆碰撞）时的物理合理性，发现高视觉质量常掩盖严重物理违规。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型评估过度依赖视觉保真度和语义对齐，无法量化生成动力学是否遵循基本物理定律，缺乏物理度量标准和从非校准视频中提取运动学信息的手段。
AI.method: 构建包含25K合成与12K真实碰撞场景的数据集，设计无标定重建管线从世界模型 rollout 中恢复3D物理属性，从时空一致性、动量/动能守恒、世界动力学完整性三个维度进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 大量基准测试表明，当前最先进世界模型的高感知质量常常掩盖了复杂交互过程中的严重物理违规行为。
AI.conclusion: CrashTwin 为开发具备物理可信度的世界模型提供了关键诊断工具，推动其向可靠的真实世界仿真方向发展。

title: FADE: Mitigating Hallucinations by Reducing Language-Prior Dominance in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucination, generating content inconsistent with the input image. Recent studies attribute this to the dominance of language priors over visual inputs and employ contrastive decoding methods to mitigate this dominance, but the mechanistic origin remains unexplored. We investigate the information flow through each transformer layer and find that attention modules consistently aggregate visual evidence, while FFN modules at critical layers act as the source of language priors. These priors can override visual evidence, causing correct predictions in intermediate layers to drift toward incorrect outputs. Based on this insight, we propose FADE (FFN Attenuation for DEcoding), a training-free method that attenuates FFN outputs to reduce language-prior dominance. Evaluations on POPE, CHAIR, and MME benchmarks across LLaVA-1.5, mPLUG-Owl2, and InstructBLIP show that FADE effectively mitigates hallucinations while preserving inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LVLM的幻觉源于特定层FFN模块产生的语言先验压制了视觉证据，提出通过衰减FFN输出来缓解幻觉的训练无关方法FADE。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽发现语言先验主导导致LVLM产生幻觉，并采用对比解码缓解，但缺乏对其机制来源的深入探索。
AI.method: 分析每层Transformer的信息流，发现注意力模块聚合视觉证据，而关键层的FFN模块产生语言先验；据此提出FADE方法，在解码时衰减FFN输出以降低语言先验的主导作用。
AI.result: 在POPE、CHAIR、MME基准上对LLaVA-1.5、mPLUG-Owl2、InstructBLIP进行评估，FADE有效缓解幻觉且保持推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了LVLM幻觉的机制根源（FFN层产生的语言先验压制视觉证据），并提出一种无需训练、高效实用的幻觉缓解方法。

title: To Reason or to Fabricate: Reasoning Without Shortcuts via Hint-Anchored Pairwise Aggregation
summary: While reinforcement learning (RL) significantly enhances LLM reasoning, its efficacy is severely undermined by Pre-RL data overlap, where RL datasets overlap with pretraining or SFT corpora, causing models to exploit shortcuts by memorizing correct answers and fabricating post-hoc reasoning. To address this, we introduce HIPPO, a novel RL framework that integrates hint-injected aggregation with a tailored pairwise reward model. By utilizing hint injection to deliberately trigger overlap-induced behaviors, the resulting traces naturally serve as explicit anchors for pairwise comparison. This provides highly discriminable preference signals, enabling a lightweight judge model to reliably distinguish genuine reasoning deduction from shortcut-driven rationalization, while the pairwise formulation ensures stable and robust optimization compared to standard PRMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HIPPO yields substantial improvements over standard baselines and generalizes effectively to out-of-distribution general tasks, showing it extracts authentic, transferable reasoning skills rather than superficial shortcut patterns.

AI.tldr: HIPPO框架通过提示注入聚合和配对奖励模型，有效解决强化学习中的预训练数据重叠问题，防止模型利用记忆捷径生成虚假推理，从而提取真正的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能增强LLM推理能力，但预训练或SFT数据与RL数据集重叠会导致模型走捷径——直接记忆正确答案并编造后验推理过程，这严重削弱了RL的效力。
AI.method: 提出HIPPO框架，包含两个核心：1) 提示注入（hint injection）主动触发重叠诱导行为；2) 配对奖励模型（pairwise reward model）利用这些行为痕迹作为显式锚点进行偏好对比，实现稳定的成对优化。
AI.result: 实验表明HIPPO相比标准基线显著提升性能，并能有效泛化到分布外的一般任务，证明其提取的是真实、可迁移的推理技能而非表面捷径模式。
AI.conclusion: HIPPO通过主动暴露并对比利用数据重叠的捷径行为与真正的推理过程，提供强判别性的偏好信号，实现更稳健的RL优化，提取出可泛化的本质推理能力。

title: X-Mind: Efficient Visual Chain-of-Thought via Predictive World Model for End-to-End Driving
summary: Predicting future states is essential for autonomous agents, yet current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fundamentally lack this capability, relying instead on reactive perception-action mapping. While integrating Predictive World Models (PWMs) addresses this gap, existing approaches either incur prohibitive cascaded latency or act as shallow terminal tasks that fail to deeply embed forward-looking reasoning. To endow VLA models with this reasoning capability, we propose X-Mind. Rather than treating PWMs as an external auxiliary module, this framework internalizes them as the Visual Chain-of-Thought (Visual CoT). By enforcing a world rollout prior to action, the model is constrained to imagine future evolution first, yielding a driving policy that is robustly grounded in environmental dynamics and aware of the future consequences its actions will unfold. The challenge here is efficiency, and we tackle it on two fronts. First, we introduce a compact representation of visual thinking: an abstract sketch that fuses a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) layout with abstract driving priors (e.g., navigation intents and traffic rules). Rather than rolling out dense future frames, the model reasons over this sketch as a mental canvas; aided by a Deep Compression Autoencoder (DC-AE), a 12-frame future rollout is reduced to merely 96 tokens, alleviating the long-context computational bottleneck. Second, to accelerate generation further, we propose a recurrent block diffusion scheme that unrolls the denoising steps across the layers of the large drive model, folding iterative refinement into the backbone's one forward pass. Trained and validated on large-scale real-world data, X-Mind achieves competitive end-to-end driving performance, which makes it a highly practical, low-latency solution that successfully deploys large-scale cognitive reasoning directly onto resource-constrained vehicle platforms.

AI.tldr: X-Mind通过将预测世界模型内化为视觉思维链，使VLA模型具备前瞻推理能力，并提出紧凑草图表示和循环块扩散方案实现高效低延迟的端到端自动驾驶。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型缺乏预测未来状态的能力，仅依赖反应式感知-动作映射。现有PWM方法要么延迟过高，要么仅作为浅层任务，未能深度融合前瞻推理。
AI.method: 提出X-Mind框架：1) 将PWM内化为视觉思维链（Visual CoT），强制模型在动作前进行未来推演；2) 紧凑草图表示：BEV布局融合驾驶先验知识，通过DC-AE将12帧未来推演压缩至96个token；3) 循环块扩散方案：将去噪步骤展开到模型各层，在前向传播中完成迭代优化。
AI.result: 在大规模真实世界数据上训练和验证，实现了具有竞争力的端到端驾驶性能，同时具备低延迟特性。
AI.conclusion: X-Mind是一种高实用性的低延迟解决方案，成功将大规模认知推理部署到资源受限的车载平台上。

title: How Much Due Diligence Before You Bid? Learning in Intractable Takeover Auctions
comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/imperfect-information-deal-games
summary: When two companies bid to buy the same target, no one knows exactly what the target is worth. Each bidder pays for due diligence: costly, imperfect homework that sharpens its own private estimate before it bids. How much of that homework is worth buying? We build a simple computer model of the bidding contest and let it teach itself to bid well by playing against itself, the way a game engine learns chess. The economic question, how much diligence pays for itself, and the computational question, when the contest becomes too complex to solve exactly, are both controlled by a single thing: how many pieces of private information a bidder carries. Our main finding is that the right amount of diligence is modest and finite. It falls as diligence gets more expensive, and it falls further when both sides are doing their homework, because competition erodes the value of knowing more. We also test a recent claim from AI research: that simple, general self-play methods can rival the specialized, expensive algorithms usually built for games like these. Running on an ordinary laptop with no costly frontier AI, we find the simple methods are the best of the self-learning approaches, though purpose-built exact methods still win whenever the game is small enough to solve outright. The simple methods earn their keep only once the game grows too large to solve exactly, which is the regime real deals live in, and there we show they still find strong bidding strategies. The contribution is threefold: a cheap, reproducible way to study deal-making under uncertainty; a concrete, model-based answer to how much due diligence is worth buying; and evidence about when lightweight, general-purpose AI is good enough to replace specialized methods. We release all the games, code, and experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自对弈强化学习模型，研究竞标过程中尽职调查的最优投入量，发现适度的尽职调查最优，且竞争会降低信息价值。同时验证了简单自对弈方法在复杂场景下能替代专用算法。
AI.motivation: 在竞标收购中，买家需要投入成本进行尽职调查来获取私有信息，但信息边际价值递减且竞争会侵蚀其收益。现有理论难以精确求解复杂竞标场景，需要一种可复现的计算方法来研究最优调查投入。
AI.method: 构建了一个竞标博弈的计算模型，采用自对弈(self-play)强化学习方法让模型自我训练优化竞标策略，类似于围棋引擎AlphaZero的学习方式。通过控制竞标者携带的私有信息数量来调节问题复杂度。
AI.result: 适度的尽职调查投入最优且有限；调查成本上升时投入下降；双方竞争进一步降低最优投入。简单自对弈方法在问题规模过大无法精确求解时，能胜过其他自学习方法，虽不及专用精确算法但在现实复杂场景中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 研究有三方面贡献：提供了一种廉价可复现的研究不确定交易的方法；给出了基于模型的最优尽职调查投入量答案；证明了轻量级通用AI在复杂博弈中足以替代专用方法。所有代码和实验均已开源。

title: Stochastic Optimal Control Sampling for Diffusion Inverse Problems
summary: Benefiting from the strong ability to capture data distributions, diffusion models have become powerful tools for solving image inverse problems. The key is to controllably steer the sampling trajectory toward the measurements while respecting the diffusion prior. In this work, we introduce Stochastic Optimal Control Sampling (SOCS), which models the denoising process as a dynamical system and injects control signals via SOC. Previous SOC-based approach addresses inverse problems by optimizing over the entire trajectory, which is computationally expensive. In contrast, we derive a closed-form control update and apply it at each sampling step, pulling the measurement-consistent clean prediction back onto the denoising flow. In SOCS, we can readily modulate the control strength to align with the diffusion model's native capabilities and thereby enhance perceptual quality. Our method is compatible with a variety of linear stochastic differential equation backbones. Extensive experiments across a broad spectrum of image inverse tasks demonstrate that SOCS achieves accurate measurement-aligned reconstructions with improved visual fidelity and stronger quantitative performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机最优控制采样（SOCS）方法，将扩散模型的去噪过程建模为动态系统，通过闭合形式的控制更新在每一步注入控制信号，实现测量一致性与扩散先验的平衡，在多种图像逆问题上取得更优的视觉和定量效果。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像逆问题中表现优异，但现有基于随机最优控制（SOC）的方法需对整个轨迹进行优化，计算成本高昂。本文旨在提出一种高效的闭合形式控制更新方法，降低计算复杂度同时保持优良性能。
AI.method: 将去噪过程建模为动态系统，推导出闭合形式的控制更新，在每一步采样中应用该控制，将测量一致的干净预测拉回到去噪流上。可灵活调节控制强度以匹配扩散模型的原生能力，兼容多种线性随机微分方程骨干网络。
AI.result: 在广泛的图像逆任务（如图像修复、超分辨率等）上进行大量实验，SOCS实现了准确的测量对齐重建，视觉保真度和定量指标均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SOCS通过高效的闭合形式控制更新，有效平衡了测量一致性与扩散先验，为扩散模型在图像逆问题中的应用提供了一种计算高效且性能优越的解决方案。

title: Agent-Computer Observation Interfaces Enable Dynamic Computer Use
summary:
SWE-agent established the action interface as an underexplored design axis for software-engineering agents; we make the analogous case for the observation interface in computer-use (CU) agents. Current CU agents, closed and open-source alike, tie observation to action--one screenshot every 3-5 s, no audio--leaving them blind and deaf between screenshots to video, animations, transient UI events, meetings, and spoken instructions. We introduce the Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI), a model-agnostic perception layer that decouples continuous, adaptive observation from discrete actions through three gated components: inter-step keyframe capture, volume-gated audio transcription, and CU-model-generated visual narration that persists as text. Each produces almost nothing on static, silent content, reducing to the standard loop without degrading it.
  On DynaCU-Bench (100 dynamic browser tasks plus a 50-task static control), CU models from 7B to frontier scale gain +17 to +48 pp over their screenshot baselines with zero retraining, turning tasks that are near-impossible from periodic screenshots into largely solved ones. The gap is starkest on audio: on a spoken-content subset AOI agents solve every task, whereas streaming voice models hear accurately but cannot act on what they hear without the scaffold. The decomposition is as informative as the headline gain: keyframe selection turns out not to matter--the value comes from narrating captured frames into persistent text--and the interface is not a fixed bundle, since on a newer model (Gemini 3 Flash) the keyframe stream actively regresses through image-token dilution, so its components must be selected per model rather than shipped as one configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI)，通过解耦连续观测与离散动作，显著提升计算机使用智能体的感知能力，在动态任务中取得+17到+48个百分点的提升。
AI.motivation: 当前计算机使用智能体（无论开源还是闭源）的观测接口与动作紧密耦合，只能每隔3-5秒获取一张截图且无音频，导致在视频、动画、瞬态UI事件、会议和语音指令等场景下"又盲又聋"，亟需一种更灵活的观测范式。
AI.method: 提出AOI（Agent-Computer Observation Interface），一个模型无关的感知层，包含三个门控组件：(1) 跨步关键帧捕获；(2) 音量门控音频转录；(3) CU模型生成的视觉叙述（持久化为文本）。每个组件在静态/无声内容下几乎不产生额外输出，退回标准循环而不降低性能。
AI.result: 在DynaCU-Bench（100个动态浏览器任务+50个静态控制任务）上，7B到前沿规模的CU模型相比截图基线获得+17到+48个百分点的提升，无需重新训练。在音频子集上，AOI智能体解决了所有任务。消融实验发现关键帧选择本身不重要，价值在于将捕获帧叙述为持久文本；且AOI组件需按模型选择，并非固定捆绑。
AI.conclusion: 解耦观测与动作的接口设计是提升计算机使用智能体感知能力的有效方向；不同模型对观测组件的需求不同，需根据模型特点灵活配置而非一刀切。

title: BREIT: A Framework for Brain Stroke Reconstruction using Multi-Frequency 3D EIT
summary: Multi-Frequency Electrical Impedance Tomography (MF-EIT) is a non-invasive, low-cost modality that reconstructs electrical property distributions from boundary voltages. For stroke imaging, progress in 3D deep-learning reconstruction is limited by the lack of large-scale datasets with paired ground-truth (GT) volumes and by non-standardized pipelines for data generation, simulation, and evaluation. We introduce BREIT, a modular framework for 3D MF-EIT stroke reconstruction providing: (i) a neuroimaging-to-EIT pipeline that converts CT/MRI into frequency-dependent GT admittivity volumes; (ii) a self-contained Python 3D Complete Electrode Model (CEM) forward solver for simulating MF-EIT voltages; and (iii) a 3D D-bar implementation supporting non-uniform electrode layouts. Building on BREIT, we propose dFNO-bar, which integrates Fourier Neural Operators into D-bar by learning a mapping from scattering data $t(ξ)$ to conductivity $σ(x){=}\Re\{γ\}$. We evaluate dFNO-bar against D-bar, Deep D-bar, and Gauss--Newton reconstructions on UCLH-matched synthetic data, and observe higher brain SSIM with comparable CC across noise settings. Code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/djahiddj13/BREIT
